title: AI Video Creator & Editor: Paid Social Ads for US Brands (Full-time, Remote)

About Joops

Joops is an AI company. We built our own technology for making video ads with AI, and we use it to create performance ads for direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands in the US. You’ll make ads with our tools every day and help shape them.



We’re looking for a creator who knows the difference between a video that looks good and a video that sells.



What you’ll do



Create video ads from script to final cut with Joops and other AI tools (Seedance, Higgsfield, Kling, Midjourney, and whatever comes out next)

Edit for paid social (Meta, TikTok, YouTube), handling pacing, captions, music and sound

Build every ad on a proven structure: a hook that stops the scroll, then the problem, the solution, proof, and a clear call to action

Make new versions of winning ads, and learn from how they perform (hook rate, hold rate, CTR)

Work with our team on Slack and deliver on deadline



Who you are



You understand social media and paid ads: why the first 3 seconds matter, what makes people stop scrolling, and how an ad gets a click

You use AI image and video tools hands-on and keep up with new models

You have good taste in film, photography, fashion or art. You notice lighting, color, framing and wardrobe.

You speak fluent English and know what sounds natural to a US audience

You have a portfolio of work you’re proud of

You’re fast, reliable and take feedback well



Nice to have



You’ve made ads for DTC or e-commerce brands (UGC-style, VSLs, product demos)

Some of your ads have scaled



Details



Full-time, remote, 40 hrs/week

ABOUT THE ROLE

s, and text messages

title: Operations & Administration VA | Electrical Trades, SOP Building
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with strong, verifiable operations or EA experience, ideally from a trades or construction business, and demonstrable SOP-building skills will be prioritised for this role.



An electrical business needs a self-directed, operations-first VA to take ownership of business administration, job management and SOP documentation. The role is operations and administration-led, not marketing-led — social media and website work remain part of the role, but at a scheduling and execution level, with content strategy handled by an external specialist. This is a strong, self-directed operator role: both directors want someone who takes a task, owns it completely, and delivers without needing to be followed up — someone who pushes back, asks good questions, and suggests a better way when they see one.



The role starts at 20 hours per week (4 hours per day, Monday to Friday), with the expectation this grows to full-time reasonably quickly as more tasks are handed over. A broader goal is a fully documented, less founder-dependent business that could run — or be sold — without day-to-day founder involvement by the end of 2027.



What You’ll Own



Operations, Administration & SOP-Building (Primary Focus)



General business administration support: assisting with quotes, invoicing for jobs, and timesheet administration in preparation for payroll

Contribute to building a fully documented, less founder-dependent business

Build out SOPs directly in Asana as processes are established, breaking each task down with the responsible person, day, and expected duration



Job Management (Katipolt)



Manage the back end of the job management platform: job cards, materials uploads, scheduling support, and related workflow

Draft invoices on job completion for maintenance and smaller jobs

Support quoting in the platform

Assist with materials coordination, including checking supplier deliveries and confirming gear is ready for upcoming jobs



Process Documentation



Document new workflows and processes as they’re refined and established — building the SOP library directly off live processes

Store and link all SOPs in Asana, accessible via the mobile app so field-based staff can reference them

Set a quarterly SOP review cadence to keep documentation accurate as the business evolves



 & Customer Communication



Monitor the inbox for customer replies to the business’s automated follow-up sequence, respond where appropriate, and close the loop in the system

Support customer communication throughout the job lifecycle, from initial enquiry through to job completion and follow-up

Manage customer comms within the job platform where possible



Social Media & Website (Scheduling-Level, Not Strategist-Level)



Receive approved content and manage scheduling and light repurposing (e.g. turning a video into a carousel or still-image post) across Instagram,
 and 
 using Meta Business Suite

Update and maintain the WordPress website with minor copy and photo changes as directed — no major redesign or SEO landing-page work required



Business Development & Lead Pipeline



Build and manage a lead pipeline in Asana, moving prospects through stages from initial enquiry to converted client

Manage and improve the quote follow-up process, ensuring no opportunities go cold without contact

Develop and document customer journey touchpoints: enquiry, quote, job commencement, completion, and follow-up/review request

Support outreach and marketing materials as directed



Task & Communication Management



Send a morning WhatsApp message each day with planned priorities

Send an end-of-day
 report covering tasks completed, work in progress, and items requiring attention or approval

Manage the Asana task board across daily, weekly and monthly cadences

Record training calls and use the recordings, plus AI tools, to generate SOP drafts

Participate in regular video calls, including impromptu calls while a director is on the road



What We’re Looking For



Experience



Strong general business administration or EA background, with trades or construction industry exposure strongly preferred

Experience with business process documentation or SOP creation, ideally including breaking tasks into responsibility, cadence and time-per-task

Experience with job management, CRM or trades platforms (Simpro, ServiceM8, Tradify or WunderBuild experience is highly transferable)

Experience drafting invoices, supporting quoting processes, or managing job administration in a service business



Technical Proficiency (Core, Non-Negotiable)



Asana: experience or strong ability to set up and manage task boards, project pipelines and linked SOPs

Microsoft 365/Teams: comfortable with Outlook
, Teams video and associated tools

Confident, fast learner on job management or trades platforms

AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT): genuine, proactive curiosity, not just baseline familiarity — actively pushes their own use of these tools rather than waiting to be shown

Strong written English for professional, client-facing communications



Technical Proficiency (Nice-to-Have)



Instagram and
 scheduling and 
 via Meta Business Suite

LinkedIn page-building experience from a low base

WordPress: minor content and photo updates; SEO/landing-page skills are a bonus

Xero experience is valuable but not mandatory for day one



Communication & Independence



Proactive, not passive — raises questions, confirms understanding, and flags issues before they become problems

Earns trust quickly with busy, selective directors

Confident enough to suggest a better way and push back constructively

Comfortable on frequent video calls, including impromptu check-ins



Organisational Skills



Manages multiple concurrent workstreams (admin, job platform,
 follow-up, SOP creation, light social scheduling) without dropping the ball

Strong self-directed time management within a 4-hour daily shift

Captures tasks, ideas and follow-up items in Asana unprompted



Non-Negotiables



Demonstrable, verifiable experience — real work samples and portfolio evidence are required, not just a strong interview

Consistent performance under sustained, low-supervision conditions, week after week — not just in the first few weeks

Process-minded: sees a repeatable task and thinks about how to document it, who owns it, and how long it should take

Comfortable with ambiguity — many processes are still being built in real time, and the VA helps create them, not just follow them

Treats every output — a caption, a quote, a drafted invoice — as representing an established, 19-year business

Fast learner on new platforms, particularly the job management system and Asana



Working Arrangements

Why This Role

Real trust extended quickly to someone who proves they can be handed something and not need chasing

A business actively building AI into how it works, with room to bring your own ideas and curiosity

Growth-oriented environment with a clear path to more responsibility as the role and the business evolve

title: Financial Research & Organic Growth Analyst
description:
Job Title: Financial Research & Organic Growth Analyst



Type: Full-time · Remote · ~35-40 hours/week



Compensation: $605 –$735 USD/month (based on experience and skills)



About PyQuant

PyQuant is a financial research platform that helps individual investors evaluate public companies through fundamental financial analysis and financial statement breakdown. We focus on reported financials, long-term trends, and clear, explainable metric. No market hype or pricing involved.



We're looking for a detail-oriented researcher who understands company financials and can turn that research into useful, engaging content for retail investors, organically growing our audience.



The Role

This is a finance-first research and content role - not a social media scheduling or marketing analytics position. You will:



- Investigate public companies and verify financial claims against primary sources (yahoo finance, reuters, morning star, google finance, bloomberg, etc.)

- Turn your findings into accessible content for retail investors

- Help identify investor communities, creators, and organic channels to reach people interested in fundamental investing



What We're Looking For

1. Financial Statement Analysis:

- Comfortable reading income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements

- Able to interpret revenue growth, profit margins, earnings, debt, liquidity, cash generation, and valuation metrics

- Has identified financial statement trends YoY and QoQ using Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR)

- Can identify meaningful multi-year financial trends and explain why a metric matters (and its limitations)



2. SEC Filing Research

- Experience researching companies via 10-Ks, 10-Qs, earnings releases, and investor relations materials

- Able to locate and verify figures against original sources

- Understands reporting periods, accounting terminology, and accurate citations



3. Financial Writing & Content Development

- Strong written English; can explain complex financial concepts clearly to a retail audience

- Can turn research into company breakdowns, metric explainers, comparisons, social posts, and article outlines

- Distinguishes reported facts from interpretation and opinion



4. Organic Marketing & Audience Research

- Interested in value/fundamental investing and the retail investor community

title: Trailer Management Admin
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 1000+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data-entry role. You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.



You should be familiar with common trailer repair and maintenance issues and understand how to coordinate practical solutions with drivers, terminals, vendors, and maintenance teams. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don’t let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with route supervisors, internal team, dispatchers, carriers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Identify trailer issues, assess their operational impact, and coordinate the appropriate repair solution

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Ability to understand trailer repair issues, determine the appropriate next steps, and coordinate solutions

• Knowledge of common trailer components and issues, such as tires, brakes, lights, doors, landing gear, air lines, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and structural damage, is strongly preferred

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems is a plus

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Thursday - Monday 11 PM - 9 AM CST | Thursday - Monday 8 PM - 6 AM CST

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

title: Luxury vacation rental logo design
description:
Project Overview



Oklahoma Shores is an upscale hospitality brand managing a curated portfolio of 7 distinct waterfront properties across Eastern Oklahoma. Our collection ranges from luxury tiny cabins and a premium geodesic glamping dome tent on a 100-acre riverfront ranch to high-capacity lakefront retreat estates.

We are launching a premium direct-booking network and need a specialized Brand Identity Artist / VA to create our master logo and visual asset suite.



Visual Vibe & Guardrails



• The Aesthetic: Rustic Luxury, High-End Heritage Estate, Upscale Lodge.

• What to Avoid: Please do NOT submit concepts that are cold, sterile, hyper-modern, or abstract minimal. We want the brand to feel warm, deeply established, and rich with regional history. Avoid generic clip-art houses or basic wavy lines.



Detailed Design Brief



1. The Emblem (The Waterfront Heritage Crest):

We require a classic, elegant framed estate crest or heraldic badge using fine, whisper-thin vector line art. The crest must seamlessly weave together three specific motifs:

 • A classic rustic windmill (honoring our 100-acre Oklahoma ranch heritage).

 • Subtle rolling landscape/bluff curves (representing our position high on the Grand River bluffs).

 • Clean horizontal shoreline/water reflections at the base of the emblem.

2. Typography & Font Styling:

 • Primary Text ("OKLAHOMA"): A stately, high-character serif typeface that carries weight and history, preferably with subtle, clean chiseled edges.

 • Secondary Text ("SHORES"): A clean, sophisticated, modern sans-serif typeface with wide tracking (letter-spacing) sitting perfectly aligned beneath the primary text.

3. Color Palette: Organic, muted landscape tones. Iron charcoal/black, warm sand, and soft matte gold accents, with a brand accent of muted sage/moss green.



Required Deliverables



• Master Logo Lockup: Full brand mark containing the text layout and the crest together.

• Standalone Sub-Mark: The isolated line-art crest badge on its own (for watermarks, digital welcome books, and property merchandise like robes and signage).

• Complete Vector Source Files: Fully scalable, transparent formats including .SVG, .EPS, and high-resolution .PNG.

description:
Part-Time Backend Developer – AI SaaS, Authentication & Security



Company: FYAM  

Hours: 4–5 hours per week initially  

Contract: Freelance, part-time, with potential for ongoing work



 About the Project



FYAM is developing an AI-powered application designed to help registered managers and care providers automate administrative tasks, including care-plan creation, service-user feedback analysis and staff compliance tracking.



We have already built the initial user interface and five interconnected automation workflows. We have also documented our data structures and the intended functionality of each workflow.



Our next priority is to develop the backend infrastructure required to turn the existing application into a secure, multi-user SaaS product.



I am looking for a backend-focused developer to help implement the underlying infrastructure, connect the existing workflows and prepare the application for a controlled customer pilot.



Your Responsibilities



 1. Backend Development

- Review the existing codebase and understand the current application architecture.

- Implement and improve backend functionality using the existing technology stack.

- Connect the frontend to the database and backend APIs.

- Help integrate our existing automated workflows into a reliable application.

- Support PDF uploads, text extraction and processing for AI-assisted care-plan generation.



2. Authentication and User Management

- Implement secure user registration, login, logout and password reset.

- Support multiple care-provider organisations using the same application.

- Implement appropriate user roles and permissions.

- Ensure users can only access information belonging to their organisation and permitted role.



3. Database and Data Security

- Configure and maintain a suitable database.

- Implement appropriate database access policies and server-side authorisation.

- Apply encryption in transit and at rest using suitable managed services and configurations.

- Protect API keys, credentials and environment variables.

- Implement secure file storage, access restrictions and appropriate retention and deletion processes.

- Help establish backups and recovery procedures.



4. Testing and Deployment

- Multi-tenant SaaS architecture.

- Secure file uploads and document processing.

- GitHub, debugging, testing and deployment.

The Ideal Candidate

- Can explain technical decisions in straightforward language.

- Is comfortable working independently on small, clearly defined tasks.

Working Arrangement and Budget

How to Apply

-> Comfortable working with numbers

title: GoHighLevel Expert & Trainer – Long-Term Growth Opportunity
description:
GoHighLevel Expert & Trainer — Long-Term Career Opportunity With Growing U.S. Company



Company: Blue Carrot Solutions

Location: Remote — Philippines



Employment: Initial paid trial → Part-time collaboration → Potential full-time leadership opportunity

Starting Pay: $8–$12/hour, negotiable based on experience



Initial Hours: Approximately 10–15 hours per week, with flexibility as the project develops



We're Looking for Someone Special



Blue Carrot Solutions is an established U.S.-based digital marketing company entering an exciting new chapter.



We're building a done-for-you automation service using GoHighLevel to help small business owners spend less time managing missed calls, following up with leads, scheduling appointments, and handling repetitive administrative tasks.



Our philosophy is simple:



Your Business. Your Voice. Less Busywork.



Our initial focus is on home service businesses, including roofers, HVAC contractors, plumbers, electricians, cleaning companies, and similar businesses. Eventually, we want to offer our service to all kinds of local businesses.



We have ambitious goals. We hope to build a company serving hundreds, and eventually thousands, of customers.



But we know that building something great starts with finding the right people.



We're not simply looking for a freelancer to build a few automations. We're hoping to find someone who wants to grow with Blue Carrot for years to come.



For the right person, this opportunity could eventually develop into a full-time position with significant responsibility and leadership opportunities.



The Opportunity



We already have two trusted team members in the Philippines who have been working with Blue Carrot for years. They're dependable, hardworking, and eager to learn.



We're now looking for an experienced GoHighLevel specialist who can work alongside them to build the technical foundation of our new automation service.



Your initial responsibilities will include designing our systems, building automations, testing everything thoroughly, documenting processes, and teaching our team how to confidently manage the technology.



We want someone who genuinely enjoys sharing their knowledge and helping teammates succeed.



As our company grows, we'd love for this person to potentially become our lead GHL specialist, help manage client onboarding, communicate directly with customers, and eventually train additional team members.



We're looking for someone who sees the bigger picture and wants to help build something meaningful.



What We're Building



We're developing a standardized automation service that helps local businesses with:



Missed-call text-back and lead response.



Lead capture, follow-up, and nurturing.



Appointment scheduling and automated reminders.



Customer review requests.



CRM pipelines and customer communication.



Other practical automations that save business owners time.



Our goal is to build a system that's approximately 80% standardized and 20% customizable, allowing us to efficiently serve different types of businesses without rebuilding everything for each new client.



We want a reliable, repeatable system that can eventually support hundreds of customers.



Your Initial Responsibilities



You'll help us:



Design a scalable GoHighLevel agency structure.



Build reusable snapshots and standardized workflows.



Configure phone systems, SMS, calendars, pipelines, and integrations.



Set up and troubleshoot missed-call text-back, lead follow-up, scheduling, and review automations.



Handle or guide A2P registration and SMS compliance.



Develop a repeatable client onboarding process.



Create clear SOPs, documentation, and training videos.



Train our two existing team members through hands-on collaboration.



Help implement and test our first pilot customers.



We want someone who can build the systems correctly and teach others how to manage them.



Who We're Looking For



Technical Expertise



Strong hands-on GoHighLevel experience, preferably with agencies managing multiple client accounts.



Experience building reusable snapshots and scalable automation systems.



Advanced knowledge of workflows, triggers, pipelines, calendars, and integrations.



Experience with phone systems, SMS, A2P registration, and troubleshooting.



Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.



Communication & Personality



Excellent spoken and written English.



Comfortable communicating directly with American business owners over Zoom, phone,
, and messaging.



Patient, friendly, professional, and approachable.



Enjoys teaching, mentoring, and sharing knowledge.



Dependable, organized, proactive, and honest.



Comfortable working collaboratively with an existing team.



Excited about the opportunity to grow with a company over the long term.



Experience working with home service businesses is a plus.



Personality and teamwork matter just as much to us as technical ability.



We want someone our existing team genuinely enjoys working with, learning from, and collaborating with.



The Long-Term Opportunity



This is what makes this position different.



We'll begin with a paid trial project to make sure we're a great fit for each other.



If things go well, we'd like to continue working together as we build and launch our new service.



As Blue Carrot grows, there may be opportunities to:



Transition into consistent part-time work.



Become a full-time member of Blue Carrot Solutions.



Lead our GoHighLevel technical operations.



Manage client onboarding and technical implementations.



Serve as a primary point of contact for customers.



Train and mentor future team members.



Help shape how our company operates as we scale.



We can't guarantee how quickly our new service will grow or when a full-time position will become available.



But our genuine intention is to find someone who can prove themselves, earn our trust, and become an important part of Blue Carrot for many years.



We're not looking to constantly hire and replace freelancers.



We're looking to build a great team.



How to Apply



We care much more about your actual experience, communication skills, and ability to solve problems than a polished résumé.



Please complete the following:



1. Start your application with the words "Blue Carrot GHL."



2. Tell us about your GoHighLevel experience.



How long have you used GHL? Have you built reusable snapshots or managed multiple client accounts? Have you trained other team members?



3. Record a short introduction video (2–3 minutes).



Please introduce yourself and show us a GHL automation you've personally built, using a demo account or hiding private client information.



Explain what the automation does, why you built it that way, and one potential issue you'd watch out for.



We'd also love to hear why this long-term opportunity interests you.



4. Answer this technical question:



A roofing contractor misses a phone call while working. We want the caller to automatically receive a friendly text message, but only if the contractor didn't answer the call.



How would you configure and test this in GoHighLevel? What potential issues or limitations would you consider?



5. Answer this systems question:



If you were helping Blue Carrot prepare to onboard 100 local businesses, including roofing contractors, window tinting companies, and appointment-based businesses, how would you structure the GHL system to make onboarding fast, reliable, and mostly standardized?



6. Share your hourly rate and availability.



How many hours per week could you initially commit? Would you be interested in transitioning into a long-term, potentially full-time role as the opportunity develops?



A Personal Note From the Owner



I've been running Blue Carrot Solutions for years, and I'm excited about where we're headed.



I've learned a lot about business along the way, and one of the biggest lessons is how important it is to surround yourself with good people.



I don't want to build a company where everyone is simply completing tasks.



I want to build a company where people take pride in their work, care about our customers, support one another, and feel like they're part of something meaningful.



I have big ambitions for Blue Carrot, but I also believe in growing responsibly, treating people well, and building a company that lasts.



For the right person, I hope this is the beginning of a working relationship that lasts many years.



If you're an excellent GoHighLevel specialist who enjoys teaching, wants to take on responsibility, and is excited about helping build something from the ground up, I'd genuinely love to hear from you.



Let's build something great together.

title: Phone-First Claims Assistant – Insurance Claims Firm (US Eastern Hours)
description:
HOURS: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern, Monday–Friday (10:00 PM – 6:00 AM Philippine time)



ABOUT US

Accurate Insurance Consulting, a Cóir Risk Advisory company, is a licensed public adjusting firm. We represent homeowners and businesses in property insurance claims against their insurance companies in Virginia, Maryland, DC, Delaware, New Jersey and West Virginia. We're a small, tight team, and this role will be the voice of our office.



THE ROLE

Phones come first. You'll handle our calls with insurance carriers, clients and contractors, and between calls you'll support our claims team. Some carrier calls take five minutes and some sit on hold for an hour, so patience and persistence matter more than speed.



PHONE RESPONSIBILITIES

- Call insurance carriers for claim status, adjuster contact details, payment status and document requests

- Help file new claims with carriers by phone

- Answer and return client calls: updates, collecting documents and signatures, scheduling

- Coordinate inspection dates with contractors and carrier adjusters

- Answer incoming calls on our GoTo phone system and transfer calls to our licensed adjuster when needed



CLAIMS SUPPORT BETWEEN CALLS

- Log every call in our claims software (ClaimWizard), with clear, accurate notes

- Follow up on outstanding documents from clients and carriers

- Manage inspection and appointment scheduling

- Prepare file notes and summaries for the adjuster



IMPORTANT: This is an administrative role. You will not negotiate claims, interpret insurance policies or give advice to clients. Those go to our licensed adjuster, and knowing when to hand a call off is part of the job.



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation. US callers must understand you easily.

- At least 1 year of phone-based work with US callers (call center, customer service, insurance or medical offices preferred)

- Comfortable making outbound calls and holding firm, politely, with large companies

- Strong written English for call notes

- Reliable high-speed internet, a quality USB headset and backup power/internet for brownouts

- Available for the full US Eastern shift



NICE TO HAVE

- US insurance experience, especially property claims

- Experience with ClaimWizard, GoTo or similar CRM/phone systems



HOW TO APPLY

1. Put "Carrier Call" in your subject line. Applications without it won't be reviewed.

2. Attach a voice recording (1–2 minutes) of yourself introducing yourself, then reading this as if calling an insurance company:

"Good afternoon, my name is [your name], calling from Accurate Insurance Consulting on behalf of our client. I'm following up on the status of their claim and would like to confirm whether the adjuster has received the documents we sent last week."

3. Tell us about a difficult phone call you handled and how it ended.

title: Doctor Virtual Assistant
description:
Job Description



We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Virtual Physician to help manage patient charts, review medical records, and ensure patients are fully prepared for their upcoming procedures.



The ideal candidate will have a strong medical background, excellent attention to detail, and experience reviewing medical records, laboratory results, and diagnostic imaging reports.

Your primary responsibility will be to review every patient's chart to ensure all required documentation, testing, and pre-procedure requirements are completed and accurate.



Key Responsibilities



1. Patient Chart Review & Quality Assurance



Review patient charts thoroughly to ensure all required information is present and accurate.

Verify that patients have completed the appropriate laboratory testing and X-rays for their scheduled procedures.

Review lab results, including CBC, BMP, PT/INR, and kidney function tests, according to established protocols.

Verify that X-rays and other diagnostic imaging reports are available and within the required timeframes.

Identify missing, outdated, or incomplete medical records.

Review medical histories, medications, allergies, and relevant clinical documentation.

Flag abnormal results or potential concerns for review by the physician or licensed clinical team.

Ensure every patient chart is complete and ready for physician review before the scheduled procedure.



2. Patient Communication & Follow-Up



Contact patients to confirm that required laboratory testing and imaging have been completed.

Notify patients when their pre-procedure requirements have been completed and reviewed by the appropriate clinical team.

Follow up with patients who have missing laboratory results, X-rays, or medical documentation.

Assist patients with obtaining outstanding records and completing required testing.

Answer general questions about appointment preparation and scheduling.

Escalate medical questions or concerns to the appropriate licensed healthcare professional.



3. Procedure Readiness & Scheduling Support



Review upcoming procedure schedules to ensure patients are prepared.

Maintain an organized tracking system for patients with completed versus outstanding requirements.

Coordinate with physicians, nurse practitioners, nurses, and scheduling staff.

Identify potential issues that could delay or cancel a procedure.

Provide daily updates on patient readiness and outstanding tasks.



Qualifications

Previous experience as a Medical Assistant, Virtual Medical Assistant, Medical Scribe, or Clinical Coordinator.

Strong understanding of medical terminology, laboratory testing, and medical documentation.

Experience reviewing patient charts and working with electronic medical records (EMRs).

Ability to identify missing documentation and recognize results that require clinical escalation.

Excellent communication skills and professional phone etiquette.

Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

Ability to work independently and manage a high volume of patient charts.

Experience in interventional radiology, vascular medicine, or outpatient procedures is a plus.

Familiarity with HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements.

What We're Looking For

We want someone who is extremely detail-oriented, proactive, and dependable. This person should take ownership of ensuring that every patient's chart is thoroughly reviewed and that nothing important is overlooked before a procedure.



Our goal is to minimize cancellations, improve patient safety, and ensure every patient is fully prepared before arriving at our facilities.



Important: This is a non-licensed administrative and clinical support role. Final medical clearance, interpretation of clinical findings, and decisions about whether a patient can proceed with a procedure must be made by the appropriate licensed medical professional.

title: eClinical Works onboarding specialists Experience Required
description:
Job Posting: eClinicalWorks (eCW) Onboarding & Training Specialist



Position Title: eClinicalWorks (eCW) Onboarding and Training Specialist

Department: Healthcare Operations / Clinical Information Systems

Employment Type: Full-Time Remote with offsite support.



Position Overview



We are seeking an experienced eClinicalWorks (eCW) Onboarding and Training Specialist to support the implementation, configuration, onboarding, and ongoing training of clinical and administrative personnel across a growing network of physician practices and outpatient healthcare facilities.



The ideal candidate will possess extensive hands-on experience with the eClinicalWorks Electronic Health Record (EHR) and Practice Management (PM) platforms, including provider onboarding, clinical workflow development, staff training, system optimization, and troubleshooting.



This position requires an individual who can independently manage onboarding activities, train physicians and staff, identify workflow inefficiencies, and ensure consistent and effective utilization of eClinicalWorks across multiple locations.



Key Responsibilities



1. Provider and Staff Onboarding



* Coordinate and manage eClinicalWorks onboarding for newly hired physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, medical assistants, and administrative staff.

* Configure user accounts, role-based permissions, provider profiles, and appropriate system access in coordination with authorized system administrators.

* Assist with provider scheduling templates, appointment types, clinical documentation templates, and practice-specific workflows.

* Ensure new employees receive appropriate training before independently using the EHR.

* Develop standardized onboarding checklists and training completion requirements.

* Support onboarding of newly acquired or established practices transitioning to eClinicalWorks.



2. eClinicalWorks Training and Education



* Conduct individual and group training sessions for physicians, clinical staff, and administrative personnel.

* Provide comprehensive instruction on eClinicalWorks functionality, including:

    * Patient registration and demographics

    * Appointment scheduling and provider calendars

    * Clinical documentation and progress notes

    * Electronic prescribing (eRx)

    * Medication reconciliation

    * Laboratory and diagnostic imaging orders

    * Referral management

    * Clinical templates and order sets

    * Patient portal and communication workflows

    * Billing, charge capture, and practice management

    * Task management, telephone encounters, and clinical messaging

* Develop training manuals, quick-reference guides, instructional videos, and competency assessments.

* Provide refresher training following software updates, workflow changes, or identified performance deficiencies.



3. Workflow Development and Optimization



* Evaluate existing clinical and administrative workflows to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.

* Collaborate with physicians, clinical leadership, and operations teams to standardize workflows across multiple practice locations.

* Assist in developing and optimizing documentation templates, clinical protocols, order sets, and specialty-specific workflows.

* Support improvements in documentation accuracy, charge capture, and revenue cycle processes.

* Recommend system configuration changes to improve operational efficiency and user experience.

* Ensure eClinicalWorks workflows support regulatory requirements and organizational policies.



4. Implementation and System Support



* Participate in new practice implementations, EHR deployments, and system upgrades.

* Assist with practice setup, testing, workflow validation, and go-live readiness.

* Provide hands-on support during implementation and post-go-live stabilization.

* Troubleshoot common user issues involving documentation, scheduling, prescriptions, orders, and other EHR functions.

* Escalate technical problems to eClinicalWorks support or internal IT personnel when appropriate.

* Track reported issues, corrective actions, and resolution status.

* Maintain standardized system configuration and training documentation.



5. Compliance and Quality Assurance



* Train personnel on accurate clinical documentation and proper use of electronic health records.

* Promote compliance with HIPAA, patient confidentiality, and organizational information security requirements.

* Support appropriate documentation, coding, and billing workflows.

* Monitor completion of required onboarding and system competency assessments.

* Identify recurring user errors and implement corrective education.

* Collaborate with clinical leadership to support documentation quality and operational performance.



Required Qualifications



* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience using eClinicalWorks, preferably in implementation, onboarding, training, or EHR administration.

* Demonstrated experience training physicians, clinical staff, and administrative teams.

* Strong understanding of eClinicalWorks EHR and Practice Management functionality.

* Experience configuring clinical workflows, scheduling templates, provider profiles, and user permissions.

* Knowledge of medical office operations, patient registration, clinical documentation, and billing workflows.

* Ability to troubleshoot application-related issues and communicate effectively with technical support teams.

* Strong organizational, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

* Ability to manage multiple projects and onboarding schedules simultaneously.

* Proficiency in developing training materials, standard operating procedures, and competency assessments.

* Ability to work independently in a remote or multisite healthcare environment.



Preferred Qualifications



* Previous experience as an eClinicalWorks Trainer, Implementation Specialist, Application Specialist, or EHR Administrator.

* Formal eClinicalWorks training or certification, if available and applicable.

* Experience supporting multiple medical practices or multispecialty healthcare organizations.

* Familiarity with specialty-specific clinical workflows, including orthopedics, pain management, spine, physical medicine, and outpatient surgery.

* Experience with eClinicalWorks reporting, population health tools, and operational dashboards.

* Knowledge of revenue cycle management, charge capture, and claims workflows.

* Experience supporting EHR conversions, practice acquisitions, or multisite implementations.

* Clinical background as a Registered Nurse, Licensed Vocational Nurse, Medical Assistant, or other healthcare professional is beneficial but not required.



Performance Expectations



The successful candidate will be expected to:



1. Independently coordinate and complete provider and employee EHR onboarding.

2. Deliver effective training that prepares employees to perform assigned responsibilities within eClinicalWorks.

3. Maintain accurate training records and onboarding documentation.

4. Reduce recurring system-related errors through targeted education.

5. Support consistent EHR workflows across all assigned locations.

6. Respond promptly to training requests and application support issues.

7. Identify opportunities to improve provider productivity, clinical documentation, and operational efficiency.

8. Provide regular progress reports regarding onboarding completion, training activities, and outstanding issues.



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for a hands-on eClinicalWorks expert, not simply an individual who has used the software in a clinical or administrative role.



The successful candidate must understand how eClinicalWorks is configured, how physicians and staff use the platform, and how to train personnel to use the system accurately and efficiently.



This role requires exceptional troubleshooting skills, independent problem-solving, and the ability to translate complex EHR functions into clear, practical instructions for healthcare professionals.



Application Requirements



Applicants should submit a current resume highlighting their direct eClinicalWorks experience, including:



* Number of years working with eClinicalWorks.

* Specific eClinicalWorks modules and functionality supported.

* Experience onboarding providers and clinical staff.

* Experience developing and delivering EHR training.

* Number and types of medical practices supported.

* Experience with implementation, system configuration, and workflow optimization.

* Availability, preferred work arrangement, and compensation expectations.



Important: Direct, hands-on eClinicalWorks experience is required. General EHR experience with Epic, Cerner, Athenahealth, or other platforms alone will not satisfy this requirement.

title: Supply Chain Manager for Fashion E-commerce Store
description:
We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Manager for a growing fashion e-commerce / fashion dropshipping store. We are looking for someone who works accurately, takes responsibility, and makes sure orders are properly followed up after purchase: from fulfilment and tracking all the way to final delivery to the customer.



You will start with approximately 1 hour of work per day. As the store continues to grow and the number of orders increases, the workload and number of hours will also increase. Starting rate: $3 per hour.



🧠 Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for someone who:

• Has experience with supply chain, logistics, or order management within e-commerce or dropshipping

• Preferably has experience within fashion e-commerce or fashion dropshipping

• Has experience with ParcelPanel

• Understands fulfilment, tracking, and international shipping

• Has experience communicating directly with suppliers

• Works very accurately and is highly organised

• Can independently identify and solve problems

• Preferably identifies problems before they become bigger issues

• Takes responsibility for their work

• Speaks and writes English well

• Is reliable and consistently available

• Learns quickly

• Thinks proactively about how processes can be improved

• Is looking for a long-term position

Experience within fashion dropshipping is strongly preferred.



📦 Your Main Responsibilities

You will be responsible for the daily monitoring and follow-up of the supply chain of our fashion store. Your responsibilities include:

• Checking ParcelPanel daily

• Checking whether orders have correct tracking information

• Checking whether orders have actually been shipped

• Monitoring tracking statuses

• Checking whether shipments continue to move normally

• Making sure customers ultimately receive their orders

• Following up on open and delayed shipments

• Identifying unshipped orders and discussing them with the supplier

• Investigating missing tracking information

• Identifying incorrect or incomplete addresses

• Following up on missing house numbers and other address issues

• Checking and following up on Pick Up orders

• Identifying and following up on Return to Sender orders

• Identifying and following up on Lost in Transit orders

• Identifying and following up on Out of Stock orders

• Monitoring Shipment Delays daily

• Checking whether tracking statuses have changed

• Communicating directly with the supplier when there is an issue with an order or shipment

• Keeping Supply Chain Management Sheets accurate and up to date

• Recording issues in the correct tab

• Closing resolved issues correctly

• Identifying recurring shipping or fulfilment problems

• Reporting clearly each day which issues are still open and which have been resolved



🔍 Situations You Should Be Able to Recognise

You should be comfortable working with tracking and order statuses such as: Delivered, In Transit, Pick Up, Return to Sender, Bad Address, Address Error, Refused, Not Picked Up, Info Received, Unfulfilled, Out of Stock, Lost in Transit, Shipment Delay.



It is important that you understand which orders only need continued monitoring and which orders require action. We are not looking for someone who simply says: "This order has a problem." We want someone who immediately investigates: "Why did this happen, what is the current status, and what needs to be done to resolve it?"



🛠 Tools You Will Work With

Experience with the following tools is an advantage: ParcelPanel, Shopify, Supply Chain Management Sheets, 17Track, Yun Express, ParcelsApp, Slack, ReAmaze / Gorgias, Google Sheets.



🤝 Who Will You Work With?

You will work closely with:

title: Shopify Customer Support | Fashion & Dropshipping | 2–4 Hours Daily
description:
Shopify Customer Support | Fashion & Dropshipping | 2–4 Hours Daily



We're looking for an experienced customer support freelancer to manage
 support for our Shopify fashion store.



You'll handle customer enquiries and complaints, keep our inbox organised and take ownership of each case through to resolution. We value warm, personal communication, accurate information and reliable follow-up.



Our priorities are customer satisfaction, preventing avoidable escalations and chargebacks, and reducing unnecessary return and refund costs through fair, appropriate solutions.



About the role:



* Fully remote, with the intention of building a long-term collaboration.

* Working days: seven days a week, Monday to Sunday, including weekends.

* Workload: 2–4 hours per day, totalling 14–28 hours per week.

* Hourly rate: US$3.

* Exact working times and daily inbox coverage will be agreed before starting.



Your responsibilities:



* Respond to customer
s about products, sizing, orders, delivery and tracking in clear, natural English.

* Handle delayed or missing orders, address issues, cancellation requests, order changes and out-of-stock situations.

* Resolve complaints about fit, quality, damaged items and incorrect products.

* Review Shopify order details, tracking information and previous correspondence before replying. Request relevant additional information or photos when needed.

* Offer and process approved replacements, store credit, partial refunds and full refunds in line with our procedures, your authorisation limits and applicable customer rights.

* Adapt our
 templates to each customer's situation, concerns and tone.

* Follow up with the relevant supplier or team member on order-related issues and keep customers informed until their cases are resolved.

* Keep open cases organised, with a clear next action and follow-up date.

* Accurately record complaint reasons, products, ticket references, offers, agreed solutions and refund amounts.

* Prepare a weekly summary of recurring product issues, including products receiving two or more complaints within seven days and the associated refund amounts.

* Promptly escalate disputes, chargeback notifications, serious complaints and cases outside your authority to the owner.



What we're looking for:



* Proven customer support experience with e-commerce dropshipping stores. Direct dropshipping experience is required.

* Practical Shopify experience, including reviewing orders and processing authorised changes and refunds.

* Excellent written English and a friendly, empathetic and professional communication style.

* Experience handling return requests, sizing complaints, shipping delays and frustrated customers.

* Sound judgement when choosing an appropriate solution or d
 when to escalate.

* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to work independently.

* Experience using Google Sheets or Excel for accurate record keeping.

* A reliable computer and internet connection.

* Consistent availability every day, including weekends.



Experience with fashion stores and Parcel Panel is a plus.



We provide clear procedures,
 templates, onboarding and direct communication with the owner. We welcome practical suggestions for improving our customer service and are looking for someone we can build a lasting working relationship with.



Success in this role means providing accurate, helpful replies, meeting agreed response times, following cases through to resolution, maintaining complete records and identifying recurring problems early. Customer satisfaction and sound judgement matter alongside refund and escalation rates.



To apply, please introduce yourself briefly and answer the following questions:



1. What experience do you have providing customer support for Shopify dropshipping stores? Include the types of products and the average number of customer enquiries you handled each day.

2. Describe a difficult return, sizing or quality complaint you personally resolved. What did you do, and what was the outcome?

3. How do you organise unresolved cases, follow up with suppliers and ensure customers receive updates?

4. Which tools have you used for
 support and reporting? Which performance metrics did you track?

5. What is your time zone, and when could you start? Please confirm your availability for 2–4 hours every day, including weekends, and whether the US$3 hourly rate works for you. Mention any existing commitments that could affect your availability.



Please also include the word pizza somewhere in your response to this job post.

title: Hiring: Content Creator Specialist (E-commerce / Dropshipping)
description:
**Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term | $900 Base + $200 Performance Bonus**



We are looking for a highly skilled **Creative Localization Specialist** to join our fast-paced e-commerce team.



We launch 5–6 product funnels daily across multiple international markets and need someone who can consistently deliver high-quality, fully localized video ads and static creatives.



**This is NOT a basic video editing, translation, or AI automation position.**



Your job is to take existing competitor creatives (UGC videos, video ads, static images, etc.) and professionally recreate and localize them for our target markets.



The final result should look and sound like it was originally created for that specific market.



## Responsibilities



- Localize UGC videos, video ads, and static image creatives into different target languages.

- Accurately translate and replace ALL on-screen text, subtitles, headlines, and CTAs.

- Replace foreign-language voiceovers with realistic, native-sounding AI voiceovers.

- Ensure perfect voiceover timing, pacing, synchronization, and natural delivery.

- Adapt translations to sound natural and persuasive while preserving the original marketing angle.

- Professionally remove and replace embedded text without damaging backgrounds or reducing visual quality.

- Maintain the original creative's structure, design, emotional impact, and conversion-focused messaging.

- Handle daily creative production for 5–6 product funnels.

- Independently review and quality-check every creative before submission.

- Deliver organized, launch-ready assets within strict deadlines.



## Requirements



- Proven experience with **direct-response e-commerce / dropshipping creatives**.

- Strong experience with AI dubbing, voiceovers, and localization tools.

- Ability to manually edit, mask, track, reconstruct, and replace elements when automated tools fail.

- Strong understanding of hooks, CTAs, marketing psychology, and conversion-focused advertising.

- Excellent attention to detail and ability to spot even minor mistakes.

- Ability to verify translations for accuracy, naturalness, and cultural relevance.

- Fast turnaround times without sacrificing quality.

- Excellent time management, communication, and reliability.

- Ability to work independently without constant supervision.



## IMPORTANT — We Are NOT Looking for AI Button Clickers



If your only skill is uploading a video into an AI tool, clicking "Translate," and exporting the result, **DO NOT APPLY.**



We actively use AI tools to improve speed and efficiency, but you must have the technical skills to manually fix anything AI gets wrong.



You must be capable of:



- Manually recreating embedded text while preserving the original design.

- Fixing inaccurate translations and unnatural voiceovers.

- Handling complex videos where automated AI editing fails.

- Correcting tracking, masking, timing, and synchronization issues.

- Identifying and solving problems independently.

- Delivering professional results without relying entirely on one-click AI solutions.



**We hire for real skills, precision, and problem-solving ability — not for knowing how to operate AI tools.**



## Strict Quality Standards



We expect professional, launch-ready work with:



- Zero spelling mistakes or incorrect translations.

- No robotic or unnatural voiceovers.

- No missing or untranslated foreign-language text.

- No visible editing mistakes or poorly replaced text.

- Accurate synchronization between audio, subtitles, and visuals.

- No unnecessary loss of video or image quality.

- Consistent delivery within agreed deadlines.



Every submitted creative is subject to quality control.



Repeated avoidable mistakes, failure to correct errors, or consistently poor performance will result in a formal performance review and may lead to termination.



We expect someone who takes full ownership of their work and checks everything carefully before submitting.



## Salary & Opportunity



**$900/month base salary + up to $100/month performance bonus.**



The monthly bonus is based on quality, accuracy, reliability, and delivery performance against agreed standards.



This is a full-time, long-term position with consistent daily work and the opportunity to grow with our e-commerce operation.



## How to Apply



Please provide ALL of the following:



1. Your portfolio with examples of localized video ads and static creatives.

2. At least **2 before-and-after examples** showing the original creative and your localized version.

3. A **30–60 second screen recording** demonstrating how you manually fix a difficult editing or localization issue that AI couldn't solve properly.

4. The editing software and AI tools you use.

5. Your average turnaround time for one UGC video and one static image.

6. Your experience working with direct-response e-commerce or dropshipping brands.

7. Your availability and confirmation that you accept the stated compensation structure.



### Mandatory Application Instructions



Start your application with the exact words "Manual Skills First".



Applications missing this phrase, the required portfolio examples, or the screen recording will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a **paid practical test** involving video localization, static creative localization, and manual editing.



We are looking for a serious, highly skilled, detail-oriented specialist who can consistently deliver exceptional work at scale.



**If that's you, we'd love to see your work.**

description:

E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS ASSISTANT

MORALVE | JOB DESCRIPTION

Department: E-commerce Operations | Reports To: Operations & Supply Chain Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time | Work Arrangement: Remote



POSITION OVERVIEW

MORALVE is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, resourceful, and proactive E-commerce Operations Assistant to support the daily operations of our growing e-commerce business.



This versatile, hands-on role covers marketplace and account health monitoring, inventory tracking, customer service, logistics coordination, data entry, administrative support, and ongoing system and database maintenance.



The primary purpose is to ensure daily operations run smoothly, information remains accurate and current, and recurring tasks are monitored, documented, and completed. The assistant works closely with the Operations & Supply Chain Manager across Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.



We value reliability, initiative, follow-through, adaptability, and willingness to learn as much as previous technical experience. As familiarity develops, the role can progress from task execution toward independent ownership of routine workflows, exception identification, and project coordination.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Marketplace Account Monitoring & Maintenance

• Perform daily and recurring checks across Amazon and other assigned marketplaces.

• Monitor account health, notifications, alerts, warnings, and pending action items.



2. Inventory Monitoring & Maintenance

• Monitor inventory availability and stock health across marketplaces and inventory systems.

• Track replenishments, transfers, inbound activity, and receiving updates.

• Update inventory trackers and compare internal data against marketplace records.



3. Customer Service & Customer Experience Support

• Monitor and respond to routine customer inquiries using established guidelines and templates.

• Support order inquiries, delivery concerns, returns, refunds, and replacements within approved authority.

• Track unresolved cases, document actions, and follow up to closure.

• Identify recurring product or service issues and escalate sensitive or nonstandard cases.



4. Logistics, Shipment & Order Monitoring

• Monitor shipment and logistics updates, communications, and operational notifications.

• Maintain shipment trackers and milestones, including estimated arrival, delivery, and receiving.

• Assist with Amazon FBA, AWD, and other marketplace inbound monitoring.

• Record shipment references and organize supporting documents.

• Follow up on missing routine updates and flag delays or discrepancies.



5. Purchase Order & Supplier Coordination Support

• Maintain purchase order records, production updates, and related tracking systems.

• Monitor supplier communications, completion dates, inspection updates, and outstanding information.

• Collect quotations, documents, and routine supplier information.



6. Data Entry, Database & Tracker Maintenance

• Perform accurate recurring data entry and maintenance in spreadsheets, trackers, and databases.

• Update records using verified
s, reports, marketplace information, and supplier communications.

• Identify duplicate, missing, outdated, or inconsistent data.

• Assist with historical backtracking, cleanup, cross-checking, and reconciliation.

• Follow established data standards, formatting, and naming conventions.



7.
, Communication & Task Management

• Monitor assigned operational inboxes and channels; categorize and label communications.

• Identify and execute routine actions, follow-ups, documentation, and escalation.

• Track outstanding requests and pending responses.

• Communicate updates to internal and external stakeholders as appropriate.



8. Document & File Organization

• Download, rename, categorize, and store operational files according to company standards.

• Organize product, shipment, purchase order, inspection, supplier, and customer service documents.

• Support historical file cleanup and ensure records are traceable to their transactions.



9. Routine Operational & Administrative Support

• Complete assigned daily, weekly, and monthly checklists and maintenance tasks.

• Assist with account checks, reporting, data collection, research, and administrative activities.

• Support routine coordination across departments and evolving business needs.



10. Project Coordination & Process Improvement

• Maintain assigned project boards, task lists, deadlines, and documentation.

• Track deliverables, follow up on action items, and report blockers early.

• Assist with small operational projects and SOP documentation.

• Suggest practical improvements to accuracy, organization, and efficiency.



QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Experience in at least 3 areas: : e-commerce operations, virtual assistance, administrative support, customer service, marketplace management, inventory/order management, logistics support, or data entry.

• Working knowledge of Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel, including basic formulas, sorting, filtering, and organizing data.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, written and verbal English communication.

• Ability to interpret
s, spreadsheets, reports, and operational systems and determine routine next steps.

• Ability to manage recurring responsibilities, follow SOPs, and work independently in a remote environment.

• Reliability, accountability, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn.



Preferred

• Experience with Amazon Seller Central or similar platforms.

• Familiarity with marketplace account health, listings, inventory, orders, and e-commerce customer service.

• Experience with Google Workspace and project tools such as 
, ClickUp, Asana, or Notion.

• Basic familiarity with Amazon FBA/AWD, shipments, purchase orders, and replenishment.

• Experience working with suppliers or logistics providers and maintaining SOPs or operational trackers.



KEY COMPETENCIES

Attention to Detail - Maintains accurate records and recognizes inconsistencies.

Reliability & Consistency - Completes recurring responsibilities on time.

Ownership & Accountability - Takes responsibility and follows tasks to completion.

Proactiveness - Identifies missing information, pending actions, and potential issues.

Problem-Solving - Investigates and proposes possible solutions before escalation.

Learning Agility - Learns new tools and processes quickly.

Organization & Prioritization - Distinguishes urgent issues from routine tasks.

Communication & Follow-Through - Provides timely updates and closes loops.

Adaptability - Supports changing needs across operational functions.

Process Discipline & Judgment - Follows SOPs and recognizes when approval is required.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

• Complete daily, weekly, and monthly responsibilities accurately and on time.

• Keep operational records complete, consistent, and up to date.

• Identify and report marketplace, inventory, customer service, and logistics issues promptly.

• Track open inquiries and action items through resolution.

• Communicate progress, challenges, and blockers proactively.

• Gradually manage assigned recurring workflows with less supervision.



WORK SCHEDULE & BENEFITS

Work Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Work Arrangement: Remote

13th Month Pay: Provided annually

Paid Holidays: Paid Philippine Regular and Special Non-Working Holidays

Paid Time Off (PTO): 5 paid leave days per year

Team Environment: Collaborative and supportive remote team

Professional Growth: Hands-on exposure to e-commerce tools and operations



GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES

Initially, the role focuses on learning MORALVE's systems, completing recurring tasks accurately, and maintaining reliable records. With demonstrated consistency, accountability, and judgment, the assistant may progress toward independent ownership of operational processes, advanced marketplace and inventory responsibilities, reporting and reconciliation, workflow improvement, and cross-functional project coordination.





If these resonate with you, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply Here 👉 Initial Applicant Form : 



Our application process includes a few steps to help us get to know you better, including some initial questions, online assessments, and a short video introduction.

We recommend setting aside enough time to complete everything in one go. Please read the instructions carefully and make sure all required information is submitted.



Having trouble accessing the form? Feel free to
 us at 
 and we'll be happy to assist.



Thank you for your interest in joining MORALVE! We appreciate the time and effort you're putting into your application and look forward to learning more about you.
