title: Chargeback & Payment Dispute Specialist — E-Commerce — $6/hour
description:
We are a fast-growing international e-commerce company selling consumer products across multiple countries.



We are looking for a highly organized, reliable, and communicative Chargeback & Payment Dispute Specialist to take ownership of our payment disputes and chargebacks.



This role is especially suited for someone who is excellent at:



Following clear SOPs consistently every single day.

Staying organized even when handling many cases at once.

Keeping accurate records and documentation.

Communicating clearly with other team members.

Following up when something is missing.

Managing deadlines without needing reminders.

Paying attention to small details.

Taking responsibility for their work.



We already have clear systems and SOPs in place.



We are not looking for someone who ignores processes, skips steps, forgets to update cases, or waits until the last minute.



We want someone who can take a clear SOP, follow it accurately, communicate when something is unclear, and make sure every task is completed properly.



Your main responsibility will be to fight chargebacks, collect and submit strong evidence, communicate with our Customer Support team, track deadlines, and make sure no dispute is lost because of poor preparation, poor communication, or missed deadlines.



What Success Looks Like in This Role



A successful person in this role:



Checks every required platform every working day.

Follows our SOPs without skipping steps.

Keeps every chargeback properly documented.

Always knows which cases are urgent.

Communicates immediately when something is missing.

Follows up with Customer Support instead of waiting.

Updates statuses so the rest of the team knows what is happening.

Completes evidence before deadlines.

Double-checks their work before submitting.

Asks questions when something is unclear rather than guessing.

Takes ownership of problems until they are resolved.



Communication and organization are extremely important in this position.



If you notice a problem, we expect you to communicate it.



If you are waiting for information, we expect you to follow up.



If you cannot complete something, we expect you to explain why.



We never want issues to be ignored or left unresolved without communication.



1. Daily Chargeback Monitoring



You will monitor payment disputes across platforms such as:



Shopify Payments

PayPal

Airwallex

Mollie

Other payment providers we use



Your responsibilities include:



Check all payment platforms every working day.

Identify all new disputes.

Log every dispute immediately.

Record the dispute reason.

Record the dispute amount.

Record the evidence deadline.

Keep the status of every dispute updated.

Follow our chargeback SOP for every case.

Prioritize disputes based on deadlines.

Follow up on open disputes.

Track whether disputes are won or lost.

Communicate immediately if there is an issue you cannot solve.



No chargeback should ever be lost because someone forgot about it, skipped a step, failed to communicate, or missed a deadline.



2. Prepare & Submit Chargeback Evidence



You will prepare strong evidence for each dispute.



Depending on the dispute, evidence may include:



Order information

Customer information

Billing and shipping information

Tracking information

Proof of delivery

Shipping confirmation

Customer communication

Customer Support conversations

Refund history

Store policies

Refund policies

Shipping policies

Terms & Conditions

Screenshots

Product information

Other supporting evidence relevant to the case



You will be given clear SOPs explaining how different chargeback types should be handled.



We expect you to follow those SOPs carefully.



At the same time, you must understand the case you are working on.



Do not blindly copy and paste evidence.



Read the information.



Understand what the customer is claiming.



Make sure the evidence actually supports our case.



Double-check everything before submitting.



3. Communicate With the Customer Support Team



Communication with our Customer Support team is a very important part of this role.



You may need Customer Support to:



Contact a customer.

Send you missing information.

Explain what happened in a case.

Resolve a customer issue.

Ask a customer to collect their package.

Ask a customer to close a dispute after their issue has been resolved.

Provide screenshots or previous conversations.

Confirm whether a refund or reshipment was issued.



We expect you to communicate clearly and professionally.



Do not simply send a message and forget about it.



If you are waiting for information, follow up.



If something is urgent, make that clear.



If a deadline is approaching, communicate it.



If Customer Support has made a mistake that affects a chargeback, report it clearly so it can be corrected.



Good communication is one of the most important skills for this role.



4. Investigate Every Chargeback



Before submitting evidence, you should understand the full situation.



You should review:



The entire customer conversation.

Order history.

Tracking history.

Delivery status.

Previous refunds or reshipments.

Customer claims.

Internal notes.

Relevant company policies.



Do not make assumptions.



Do not skip information because you are in a hurry.



Follow the investigation process in our SOP and make sure you understand what happened before making a decision.



5. Deadline Management



You will often handle many disputes at the same time.



Being organized is therefore extremely important.



You will be responsible for:



Recording every deadline correctly.

Keeping an organized list of open cases.

Prioritizing urgent disputes.

Preparing evidence early.

Following up when information is missing.

Escalating problems before they become urgent.

Making sure nothing gets forgotten.



You should never need management to remind you that a chargeback deadline is approaching.



Managing your workload and deadlines is your responsibility.



6. Documentation & Organization



Every chargeback must be properly documented.



We expect you to keep clear records showing:



What happened.

What the customer claimed.

What evidence was collected.

What actions were taken.

Whether Customer Support was contacted.

What information is still missing.

When evidence was submitted.

The final dispute outcome.



Another team member should be able to open your documentation and immediately understand the status of the case.



If your work is not documented, it is considered incomplete.



7. Track Chargeback Results



You will track dispute outcomes and help us understand why we win or lose cases.



You should track things such as:



Chargeback reason.

Payment provider.

Amount.

Evidence submitted.

Outcome.

Win rate.

Reasons for losses when identifiable.



If you notice repeated problems, communicate them to management.



For example:



Customers frequently dispute delayed packages.

A specific shipping method creates many disputes.

Customer Support is handling a situation incorrectly.

Certain evidence is missing repeatedly.

We are repeatedly losing one specific type of dispute.



We want someone who notices patterns and communicates them clearly.



8. Improve Our Chargeback Process



Our SOPs are important, but they should also improve over time.



If you notice:



A repeated mistake.

An unclear SOP.

A missing step.

A better evidence structure.

A recurring communication problem.

A process that is causing unnecessary chargebacks.



You should report it.



We want someone who can follow systems extremely well while also helping us improve them.



Daily Responsibilities



Every working day you should:



Check all payment processors.

Identify new disputes.

Log all new chargebacks.

Review upcoming deadlines.

Work through active cases.

Follow the correct SOP for every dispute.

Collect missing evidence.

Communicate with Customer Support when necessary.

Follow up on unanswered requests.

Submit completed evidence.

Double-check submissions.

Update dispute statuses.

Track wins and losses.

Report urgent issues.

Make sure there are no forgotten cases.

IMPORTANT



To confirm that you have carefully read this entire job description, please start your application with the words:



CHARGEBACK SPECIALIST



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be reviewed.



What We Are Looking For



The most important qualities for this position are:



Extremely Organized



You should be comfortable handling many active cases without losing track of deadlines, follow-ups, or missing information.



Excellent at Following SOPs



We have clear processes for how work should be completed.



We need someone who can follow instructions consistently every day.



Not just during the first week.



Not only when someone is checking.



Every single day.



You should not skip steps because you believe they are unnecessary.



If an SOP is unclear, communicate with us instead of guessing.



Strong Communication



You will communicate regularly with Customer Support and management.



We expect you to:



Respond clearly.

Ask questions when necessary.

Follow up.

Communicate problems early.

Explain what you need from another team member.

Keep people updated on important cases.



Ignoring a problem is never acceptable.



Reliable



If you are responsible for something, we expect it to get done.



We should not need to repeatedly remind you about your responsibilities.



Detail-Oriented



Small mistakes in chargebacks can cost the company money.



You must be comfortable checking details carefully and reviewing your work before submission.



Proactive



If something is missing, investigate it.



If someone has not responded, follow up.



If a deadline is approaching, act early.



If you notice a repeated problem, report it.



Do not wait until someone tells you what to do.



Experience



Previous experience handling chargebacks or payment disputes is strongly preferred.



Experience with any of the following is a major advantage:



Shopify

Shopify Payments

PayPal

Airwallex

Mollie

Gorgias

Gmail

Slack

Google Sheets

Excel

WhatsApp

Performance Expectations



Your performance will be evaluated based on:



Following SOPs correctly.

No missed chargeback deadlines.

Accuracy of evidence submissions.

Quality of evidence.

Organization.

Documentation quality.

Communication with Customer Support.

Following up properly.

Reliability.

Attention to detail.

Ability to manage many cases at once.

Chargeback win rate.

Ability to identify and communicate repeated problems.



We care heavily about consistency.



Doing a good job one day and becoming disorganized the next week is not enough.



We are looking for someone who can maintain the same high standard every working day.



Salary



$6 USD/hour



Full-time position: approximately 40 hours per week.



There is potential for increased responsibility, performance bonuses, and salary growth for someone who consistently performs at a high level.



How to Apply



Please include:



Tell us about yourself.

Describe your previous chargeback or payment dispute experience.

Which payment processors have you handled disputes with?

Have you used Shopify before?

Have you worked with PayPal disputes?

Approximately how many chargebacks have you handled?

How do you organize multiple cases and deadlines?

Give an example of a job where you had to follow detailed SOPs every day.

What would you do if an SOP was unclear?

What would you do if you needed information from another employee and they did not respond?

What evidence would you use for a "Product Not Received" dispute?

What evidence would you use for a "Fraudulent Transaction" dispute?

Which software platforms have you used?

When can you start?



Please also record a 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be a good fit for this position.



Interview Questions

Question 1



You have 30 active chargebacks across four different payment providers.



Five deadlines are within the next three days.



Explain exactly how you would organize your work.



Question 2



Our SOP says that before submitting a "Product Not Received" chargeback, you must review tracking, the entire customer conversation, and any previous refunds.



You are very busy and tracking already shows "Delivered."



Would you still complete the other steps?



Explain why.



Question 3



You need information from a Customer Support agent to complete evidence.



You message them, but they have not responded after several hours and the evidence deadline is tomorrow.



What would you do?



Question 4



A customer opens a chargeback claiming that they never received their order.



Tracking shows that the order was delivered.



Walk us through exactly what you would investigate and what evidence you would submit.



Question 5



You realize you made a mistake on a case.



What would you do?



Question 6



You notice the same type of mistake happening repeatedly between the Customer Support team and chargeback team.



How would you handle it?



Final Note



We are looking for someone who is organized, reliable, communicative, detail-oriented, and excellent at following clear SOPs.



This is extremely important to us.



You will receive clear instructions and processes, but we need someone who can follow them consistently without needing to be reminded every day.



We want someone who communicates when something is wrong, follows up when something is missing, keeps their work organized, documents everything properly, meets every deadline, and takes responsibility for their tasks.



If this describes the way you work, we would like to hear from you.

title: We're Hiring: Full-Time Video Editor!
description:
About Us

Alien Prints is a fast-growing custom apparel company based in Addison, Illinois. We produce 200+ orders per month of screen-printed, embroidered, and DTF-transferred custom apparel for construction companies, service businesses, and organizations across the US.



We're searching for a creative and detail-oriented Full-Time Video Editor who can turn ideas into engaging visual content. From social media clips to marketing campaigns, you'll play a key role in creating videos that captivate audiences and elevate our brand.



Job Requirements: Must have

• 2+ years of experience editing short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

• Portfolio/reel showing at least 10 short-form videos you’ve edited

• Proficient in CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

• Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, captions, and trending formats

• Ability to turn around 8–10 short clips per day consistently

• Understanding of what makes content perform on each platform (TikTok vs Reels vs Shorts)

• Clean, professional editing style — not over-edited, not under-edited



Nice to have

• Experience editing content for product-based or service-based businesses

• YouTube long-form editing experience (chapters, b-roll, pacing)

• Motion graphics or animation skills (After Effects, Motion)

• Thumbnail design skills (Photoshop or Canva)

• Basic color correction and audio cleanup skills

• Familiarity with royalty-free music libraries and sound design



Job Overview

The role

You are the person who takes raw footage and turns it into scroll-stopping content. Every day, you will receive raw video clips from our shop floor (printing presses running, orders being made, finished products) and talking-head recordings from the owner. Your job is to edit these into short-form and long-form videos optimized for each platform.



This is a high-volume role. You will produce 8–15 edited video pieces per day across different formats. Speed, consistency, and understanding of what makes content perform on social media are essential.



What you will do

Short-form video editing (primary focus — 70% of time)

• Edit raw clips into 15–60 second videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

• Add captions/subtitles to all videos (burned-in, styled, readable)

• Write and add text hooks in the first 1–2 seconds of every video

• Add transitions, zoom effects, and pacing that match platform trends

• Select and sync trending audio/music where appropriate

• Create satisfying loop videos from production process footage (press pulls, ink shots, transfer peels)

• Edit before/after reveal videos with dramatic transitions

• Format and resize the same video for different platforms (9:16, 1:1, 16:9)



Long-form video editing (20% of time)

• Edit 1 long-form YouTube video per week (5–15 minutes)

• Full process walkthroughs: a single order from design to shipping

• Educational content: print method comparisons, branding guides, industry tips

• Add intro/outro, lower thirds, chapter markers, and b-roll where needed

• Create compelling thumbnails for YouTube videos



Ad creative (10% of time)

• Edit short video ads for Meta 
/Instagram) campaigns

• Create multiple variations of the same ad for A/B testing

• Follow direct creative briefs from the Content Manager



Daily output expectations

• 8–10 short-form videos (TikTok/Reels/Shorts format) per day

• 2–3 Stories-format clips per day

• 1 long-form YouTube video per week

• 1–2 ad creatives per week

title: Part-Time Accounting & Finance Manager | QuickBooks Online | U.S. Service Businesses
description:
Part-Time Accounting & Finance Manager

| QuickBooks Online | U.S. Service Businesses



We are looking for a long-term accounting and finance partner—not simply someone to enter transactions.

We operate multiple small U.S.-based consulting and marketing service businesses, each with separate QuickBooks Online books. Our transaction volume is relatively low, but we need an experienced person who can take ownership of the accounting function, keep the books accurate, manage routine financial operations, and proactively tell the owner what he needs to know.

If your approach is primarily categorizing bank-feed transactions and waiting for instructions, this is probably not the right role. If you naturally ask why an expense changed, notice an overdue invoice, question an unusual transaction, document recurring accounting rules, and can explain the financial picture to a busy business owner in a few minutes, we would like to hear from you.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• QuickBooks Online bookkeeping quality, account reconciliation, and proper coding across multiple entities

• Monthly close and accurate, tax-ready books

• Client invoicing and maintenance of the billing calendar

• Accounts receivable tracking and professional initial payment reminders

• Selected accounts payable and bill payment within agreed approval controls

• Weekly review of cash, receivables, upcoming bills, unusual expenses, and recurring subscriptions

• Identification of unused, duplicate, unnecessary, or unexpectedly increasing subscriptions and expenses

• Monthly management reporting with a concise explanation of what the owner actually needs to know

• Practical revenue and profitability reporting by client and service line

• Short-term cash forecasting

• Year-end preparation and coordination with our U.S. CPA/tax preparer

• Documentation and improvement of recurring finance processes

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Strong hands-on QuickBooks Online experience

• Experience independently managing reconciliations and month-end close

• Experience with U.S.-based businesses

• Consulting, marketing agency, professional-services, or similar client-based business experience strongly preferred

• Comfort working with multiple separate business entities

• Ability to build practical client-profitability reporting even when owner/partner time is not perfectly tracked

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Proactive judgment: raise your hand when something does not make sense

• Strong documentation habits so recurring instructions do not have to be repeatedly explained

• High integrity and respect for financial access and payment controls

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

This is not a CFO position. It is also not a basic transaction-entry bookkeeping position. We are looking for someone between those levels: an experienced accounting professional who can run the books and financial operations while also providing useful management information. Our U.S. CPA will continue to handle tax preparation. Your responsibility includes making sure the books and supporting information are ready for them.

TIME COMMITMENT

This is intended to be a long-term relationship. We currently estimate the steady-state workload at approximately 30–35 hours per month. The first 90 days may require a different amount of time while you learn the businesses, review the existing books, complete any required cleanup, and establish the reporting processes. We care more about ownership and results than maximizing billable hours.

THE FIRST 90 DAYS

• Existing QuickBooks files reviewed, reconciled, and cleaned up where necessary

• Material historical accounting issues identified and resolved or documented

• Client billing calendar operating reliably

• AR tracking and initial reminder process operating

• Routine approved bill-payment process operating

• Weekly owner financial summary established

• Monthly close and management reporting established

• Subscription and recurring-expense audit completed

• Short-term cash outlook established

• Initial client/service profitability reporting established

• Year-end CPA-readiness process documented

• Recurring accounting procedures and rules documented

The ultimate measure of success is simple: the owner should learn about important financial issues from you before he has to discover them himself.



IMPORTANT:

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

- Must be available for a camera-on interview.

- Must attend weekly Zoom meetings with the camera on.

- Must be available to log in from 8:00 AM ET to 10:00 AM ET, Monday through Friday.

- Must actively monitor and clean inboxes, keeping
s organized and properly addressed.

- Must create and maintain a transaction tracker covering all financial transactions across the businesses.

- Submit a Video Introduction.

title: Client Delivery Manager – B2B Consultancy, Part-Time Ongoing
description:
Our company helps founder-led B2B technology and technology-enabled services companies build repeatable revenue systems. We are hiring a Client Delivery Manager to own everything that happens after our CEO closes a sale, so that clients get an organized, accurate, on-time experience and the CEO stays out of routine delivery.



This is ongoing part-time work, 15-20 hours per week, expanding with client volume and demonstrated ownership.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Ownership transfers the moment the CEO reaches agreement with a client. From there you run:



• Contract to onboarding. Revise the agreement or statement of work to match what was actually agreed, confirm material changes with the CEO, follow through to signature, file the executed document, coordinate billing setup with accounting, and schedule onboarding.

• Day-to-day client contact. Answer questions on deliverables, schedules and revisions. Request overdue client inputs firmly and tactfully. Protect the agreed scope. Escalate anything commercial, legal or relationship-threatening.

• Calendar and meetings. Own the client-facing calendar, prepare agendas and pre-reads, capture decisions and action items, send follow-ups, and update the project the same day.

• AI workflow execution. Run our documented prompts and agents in ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini using the correct source documents and process version. Compare outputs across tools and select or combine the strongest material.

• Quality assurance. Validate claims against transcripts and source documents. Catch hallucinations, unsupported claims, omissions and generic language. Correct grammar, structure, tone and formatting. Strip every placeholder, prompt fragment and AI artifact before anything reaches the CEO or the client.

• Revisions, project visibility, billing coordination, closeout and testimonial capture.



DELIVERABLES YOU PRODUCE OR FINALIZE



• Client-ready strategy documents: buyer and ICP research, buying-committee analysis, positioning and messaging, target-account intelligence, outreach plans, revenue-process design, playbooks and operating procedures.

• Engagement documents: agreements and statements of work that correctly reflect scope, fees, timing, client responsibilities and exclusions.

• One project dashboard showing phase, deliverable, owner, status, next action, due date and risk for every active engagement.

• Meeting agendas, follow-up summaries and status updates.

• Written and video testimonials at closeout.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We care about evidence, not previous job titles. Strong candidates have come from client services, account coordination, customer success, logistics, executive support, agency operations and consulting operations, including experienced professionals working part-time by choice.



Show us:



• Managing several customer relationships or service commitments at once without losing details.

• Coordinating delivery logistics and deadlines independently.

• Excellent business writing and proofreading in English.

• Current, hands-on weekly use of generative AI tools.

• Setting expectations or boundaries with customers.

• Follow-through and sound judgment about what to solve yourself and what to escalate.



TOOLS YOU WILL USE



ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini (working proficiency required). Microsoft Word and Outlook (strong proficiency required). A transcript platform such as Krisp. Zoho Projects preferred but not required.



PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



We will train you on our delivery process and our specific client workflows. We will not train you on how to use generative AI, run prompts, use Word, write professional
 or manage a calendar. If you need that training, this is not the right fit.



We also do not move forward with anyone who submits raw or lightly edited AI output as finished work. Every deliverable is checked against source material.



TERMS



• Ongoing hourly contract, 15-20 hours per week.

• This role is expected to expand and can grow into leading our delivery function.



IN YOUR PROPOSAL/VIDEO INTRODUCTION



Answer the screening questions, then add one short paragraph on the most clients or projects you have managed at one time and how you kept control of the details.



1. What is the largest number of clients or projects you have managed at one time, and how did you keep control of the details?

2. Which generative AI tools do you use weekly, and what kind of outputs do you produce with them?

3. How do you d
 whether AI-generated content is accurate enough to send to a client?

4. Describe a time a client failed to give you something you needed. What did you say, and what happened?

5. What weekly schedule and U.S. Eastern business-hour coverage can you reliably commit to?





NOTE:

- Must be available for a camera-on interview.

- Must attend weekly Zoom meetings with the camera on.

- Must be available to log in from 8:00 AM ET to 5PM ET, Monday through Friday.

- Ongoing hourly contract, 15-20 hours per week.

s organized and properly addressed.

description:
Job description

Mivourr is looking for a Performance Video Editor to join our team! You will be responsible for editing high-converting video ads at volume, turning raw UGC footage, creator content and scripts into scroll-stopping creatives used across our paid marketing channels, with a big focus on Meta.



We are looking to hire someone with 2+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience editing paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience in health, beauty or wellness brands.



Who are we?

At Mivourr, we are dedicated to improving women’s lives by tackling a problem that’s rarely talked about: vaginal dryness and painful intimacy. Our hero product, vGlow, is an intimate red light therapy device that helps women feel comfortable and confident again. Since our launch, we have grown rapidly through performance marketing, selling worldwide with most customers in the US, Australia, UK and Canada. We operate with a small but mighty team focused on speed and continuous growth, and we’re excited to bring on a second video editor to play a pivotal role in scaling our creative output even further.



What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following core values: “work smart”, “overdeliver”, “speed is king” and “better everyday”. We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn’t it.



If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a huge role in scaling it. Drive results with a small team of passionate, smart & hardworking people. Work in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance, then you have come to the right place.



Key Objectives:

- Edit a high volume of direct response video ads on an ongoing basis, from raw footage all the way to final export

- Turn UGC footage, creator clips, b-roll and scripts into high converting creatives for Meta

- Create multiple variations of every concept (hooks, intros, CTAs, pacing, formats) to maximize testing

- Work closely with the founder and our current video editor to keep a consistent quality and fast turnaround

- Drive measurable improvements in core ad metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA) through better editing



Requirements:

- Fully remote, with reliable internet and a computer that handles fast 4K editing

- Fluent in English, with some daily overlap with European time zones

- Direct Response Expertise: 2+ years editing performance video ads for ecommerce/dropshipping brands 
, TikTok & Instagram) or at a creative agency is a must

- Tools: Proficiency in Premiere Pro, CapCut and/or After Effects. Experience with AI tools (voiceovers, upscaling, captions) is a plus

- UGC Experience: Lots of experience editing UGC-style content that feels native and authentic, not overproduced

- Creative & Analytical Mindset: Strong understanding of hooks, retention, pacing and what makes people stop scrolling, plus the ability to learn from ad performance data

- Fast and organized: you can keep quality high while working at volume under tight deadlines

- You take feedback well and turn it around quickly, without ego

- Comfortable working with women’s health and intimacy topics in a tasteful, educational way

- No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work

- Excellent cultural fit as per our values above

- Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder



Accountabilities

- Deliver 6-10 ad concepts per week (1-2 minute videos), each with 3 variations (usually different hooks)

- Produce multiple hook and format variations for every winning concept

- Add captions, text overlays, sound design, music and basic motion graphics

- Keep an organized library of footage, projects and exported assets

- Meet deadlines consistently with fast turnaround on feedback

- Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets and drive better ROI

- Suggest creative improvements and new editing styles based on emerging trends



How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate:

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.



Initial screening of your portfolio, then a trial project where you’ll edit a test ad using our raw footage, and a final interview with the founder to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8-10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.



For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!



To apply, send your portfolio with as many ads as possible that you’ve edited, ideally from the last 6 months (performance data is a big plus), and start your application with the word “Unicorn” so we know you read the full post (ONLY applications with a strong ecommerce ads portfolio will be accepted).



Salary Expectation

USD $1500 to $2500 per month + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

title: HR Lead
description:
Some important notes about this role!



-Our intent is for this employee to stay with the company for years. Opportunities for growth in responsibility and compensation will be available based on performance. If this does not fit what you are looking for, please do not apply.

-This role will work US hours, from approximately 9am-5:30pm Pacific Standard Time (with some flexibility).

-The top qualities we are looking for in candidates are: outstanding (fluent or near-fluent in a business setting) written and spoken English skills; excellent attention to detail and organization; coachability, flexibility, and desire to learn.

-Candidates must be comfortable with a one-month paid work trial at part-time hours. After the one month, the candidate will transition to the full-time role with the company. If you are not comfortable with this, please do not apply.

-Time tracking will not be required in the role after the one-month trial.

-We do not expect you to know how to perform all responsibilities from day one. You will be trained on your assignments. What we do expect is for you to be eager to learn, and follow instructions with strong organization and attention to detail.

English language skills (spoken & written) to support a fast-growing, multi-location franchise education

business in the U.S. The candidate must be available during US hours.



This is not a basic VA role — you will act as the operational backbone for HR, recruiting, payroll

coordination, onboarding, compliance, and related HR systems across multiple

locations. 



Your job is to reduce chaos, streamline workflows, and ensure clean execution across

HR as we scale. The successful candidate will be ready to operate in a fast-moving startup setting, ready to help build an HR function (not just follow existing systems/processes), in an environment with some ambiguity. 



Key Responsibilities



Recruiting

• Talent Pipeline Development

• Recruiting Platform Management

• Initial Candidate Screening



HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle

• Manage onboarding for new hires

• Maintain employee records and ensure all documentation is complete and compliant

with California employment laws

• Support offboarding processes



Payroll Coordination (Paylocity)

Compliance

Reporting & Process Improvement

• Maintain clean tracking sheets for: Payroll status, Onboarding progress, Compliance

items

• Identify inefficiencies and propose improvements

• Help build simple, scalable SOPs for all recurring tasks



Ideal Candidate Profile

• 5+ years experience working in Human Resources and/or Recruiting roles.

• Availability during US hours (ideally with prior experience working US hours)

• Excellent spoken and written English communication (clear, concise, professional)

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail

• Experience working with U.S.-based businesses (required)

• Familiarity with: Payroll systems (Paylocity strongly preferred); HR processes

(onboarding, terminations, employee records); Google Suite (Google Sheets, Google

Docs)

• Able to work independently and drive tasks to completion without handholding



Application Instructions

title: Amazon Launch Specialist / Brand Manager - Private Label - Long Term, Well Paying, Stable, Remote
description:
About the Role



We are a USA based business selling our own custom branded private label products on Amazon USA. We are expanding our catalog and need support with our growth. We are looking for an experienced Amazon Launch Specialist to take ownership of our product launch execution, catalog management, listing optimization, and daily Amazon operations.



This role requires hands-on Amazon Private Label experience. You will work closely with a small team to drive product growth, improve listing performance, monitor account health, and support new product development from research through post-launch optimization.



We are looking for someone who is excited about launching new products on Amazon. The candidate should work independently, solve problems proactively, and provide clear, data-driven recommendations while maintaining a high level of accuracy and organization.



Key Responsibilities



Product Launch & Growth

- Coordinate new product launches, listing readiness, inventory planning, and launch execution.

- Monitor post-launch performance including sales, conversion rates, keyword rankings, reviews, inventory levels, and competitor activity.

- Identify opportunities to improve traffic, conversions, profitability, and sales performance.



Amazon Listing & Catalog Management

- Create, optimize, and maintain Amazon listings, including titles, bullet points, descriptions, backend keywords, and variation structures.

- Conduct keyword research and SEO optimization using keyword tools

- Monitor listing health, suppressions, stranded inventory, catalog errors, and compliance issues.

- Manage flat file uploads, variation troubleshooting, browse node updates, and catalog maintenance.



Seller Central Operations

- Manage daily Amazon Seller Central activities and account operations.

- Monitor account health, customer feedback, returns, compliance issues, and operational risks.

- Create and manage Amazon support cases, dispute tickets, and issue resolution processes.

- Ensure products remain compliant with Amazon policies and marketplace requirements.



Reporting & Performance Analysis

-Track key performance metrics including sessions, conversion rate, sales, keyword rankings, profitability, inventory levels, and BSR.

-Prepare regular reports with actionable recommendations, priorities, risks, and next steps.

-Maintain organized documentation, trackers, Google Sheets, and operational records.



Product Research & Development Support

-Conduct product, market, competitor, and review analysis to identify product opportunities and improvement ideas.

-Provide clear recommendations supported by research and business reasoning.



Qualifications

-2+ years of hands-on Amazon Private Label experience.

-Strong experience with Amazon Seller Central and related Amazon 3rd Party Tools

-Proven experience managing listings, catalog operations, product launches, and account health.

-Strong knowledge of Amazon SEO, keyword research, competitor analysis, and conversion optimization.

-Experience with variation creation, suppression recovery, flat files, compliance cases, and catalog troubleshooting.

-Understanding of Amazon FBA operations, inventory planning, and replenishment management.

-Comfortable using AI tools

-Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

-Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets.

-Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

-Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and provide clear updates and recommendations.

-Comfortable using SOPs while exercising sound business judgment and critical thinking.



Preferred Attributes

-Detail-oriented and highly organized.

-Proactive and solution-focused.

-Data-driven decision maker.

-Comfortable working in a growing e-commerce environment.

-Collaborative team player with strong ownership mentality.



What Success Looks Like

-Healthy and optimized Amazon catalog with minimal downtime.

-Successful product launches executed on schedule.

-Continuous improvements in keyword rankings, conversion rates, and sales performance.

-Strong account health and compliance management.

-Clear communication, reporting, and execution across all Amazon operations.



What the Company Offers

100% Remote

Competitive pay, incentives, 13th month, bonuses

Career growth & long-term stability

Learning & Development Opportunities



Technical Requirements

- Reliable PC/Laptop

- High-Speed Internet Connection (with Backup Solution is a plus)

- Quiet, Dedicated Workspace for Professional Remote Work

title: Editorial / Educational DOCX Template Designer
description:
I am looking for an experienced editorial / educational document designer to create the universal lesson-packet design system for AnyText, an AI-assisted platform for adult ESL teachers.



PROJECT:

$300 fixed-price project. Some flexibility for an exceptional candidate with highly relevant experience.



AnyText takes an authentic article or transcript, adapts it to an adult ESL proficiency level, generates coordinated instructional activities, and exports the finished lesson as an editable Microsoft Word DOCX.



This is NOT simply a beautification project.



I need a professional, reusable document-design system that can eventually be implemented programmatically by my developer.



The template must work with VARIABLE CONTENT.



For example:

- A reading may be 1, 2, or 3+ pages

- Titles and questions may vary in length

- Activities may be included or omitted

- Sections may contain different numbers of items

- Images may be present or absent

- Teachers may edit the DOCX after export



The design therefore must reflow gracefully. I am not looking for one beautiful static mockup that only works with one sample lesson.



My developer will handle the DOCX programming. You will design the visual system and provide clear specifications he can implement.



DESIGN DIRECTION:



Adult-accessible editorial design.



Professional, scholarly, warm, calm, readable, restrained, and appropriate for adult learners.



Visual inspiration includes:

- The forest-moon atmosphere of Endor from Star Wars

- University libraries and reading rooms

- Independent bookstores

- Forest-facing study spaces

- The warmth and craftsmanship of older Starbucks interiors

- Oxford University Press

- Cambridge University Press

- The New York Times

- The Economist

- National Geographic



These are inspiration references only. I do not want literal Star Wars imagery, trees, fake wood, coffee-shop graphics, or a fake newspaper design.



The established AnyText palette is:



Deep Forest Green — #183F36

Dark Green-Black — #1F2B27

Charcoal — #303633

Mushroom Taupe — #A79D90

Warm Stone — #D8D1C6

Parchment — #F2EDE3

Paper White — #FCFBF8

Bronze / Umber — #8B6B50



I am NOT looking for a new color palette.



The final document must also remain professional when printed or photocopied in black and white.



SECTIONS TO DESIGN INCLUDE:



- Article title and metadata

- Images

- Contextual Introduction

- Key Concepts

- Warm-Up

- Main Reading

- Vocabulary Matching

- Vocabulary Fill-in-the-Blank

- Multiple Choice

- True / False

- Short Answer

- Discussion

- Pair Work

- Mingle

- Answer Key

- Headers / footers

- Page numbering



Each activity should belong to one unified visual system while still supporting its instructional purpose.



For example:

- Reading should feel like a professionally published educational reader

- Short Answer needs appropriate writing space

- Discussion should feel spacious and reflective

- Pair Work should make roles immediately understandable

- Mingle should support printable cut-apart strips/cards

- Answer Key should be compact and easy for teachers to scan



The final specification should define:



- Exact fonts

- Font sizes and weights

- Heading hierarchy

- Reading-body typography

- Directions and question styles

- Metadata treatment

- Line and paragraph spacing

- Margins

- Tables

- Borders

- Answer spaces

- Image placement and sizing

- Headers / footers

- Page numbering

- Page-break behavior

- Color usage

- Black-and-white behavior

- Rules for variable-length content



EDITABLE DOCX IS IMPORTANT:



Teachers will be able to rewrite questions, add notes, delete material, and otherwise edit the exported Word document.



The design therefore needs a strong underlying style system rather than fragile manual formatting.



ORIGINAL HUMAN DESIGN WORK REQUIRED:



I already use AI extensively to create educational resources and to develop AnyText. I am not hiring someone because I need another person to generate educational materials with AI.



I am hiring for professional HUMAN editorial and educational design judgment.



Please do not submit AI-generated workbook mockups or AI-generated template images that cannot function as a real editable document system.



I have worked with textbooks and instructional materials for many years and am specifically looking for someone with real experience in typography, page composition, long-form layout, educational publishing, or book/workbook design.



IDEAL EXPERIENCE:



- Editorial design

- Book / textbook / workbook layout

- Educational publishing

- Adobe InDesign

- Typesetting

- Master pages

- Paragraph / character / object styles

- Print production

- Microsoft Word / DOCX templates

- Dynamic or variable-content documents



I will provide:

- The existing AnyText logo

- The established visual direction

- The established color palette

- Several real AnyText-generated lesson packets



HOW TO APPLY:



Please send:

1. A short introduction

2. 3–5 highly relevant portfolio samples

3. Any book, textbook, workbook, educational, editorial, report, or long-form layout examples

4. Any experience with Microsoft Word / DOCX templates

5. Any experience designing for variable or dynamically generated content

6. Your project estimate and turnaround time

7. One relevant portfolio piece and three design decisions you personally made on that project and why



Please begin your application with:



FOREST READER



FINAL STANDARD:



Whether an AnyText packet is 4 pages or 14 pages, a teacher should be able to download it, make small edits, print it, staple it, and hand it to an adult ESL class—and it should still look like it came from a professional educational publisher.

title: Short Form Video Editor (Reels / TikToks) — Content Agency
description:
About us:

We’re a content agency that produces short form video for business owners — scroll stopping Reels and TikToks that get our clients real results, not just views. We shoot the raw footage; you turn it into finished, ready to post content. This is a long-term role with real room to grow.



What you’ll be doing:



Editing vertical short form videos (15–60 sec) from our raw footage — Reels, TikToks, Shorts



Creating on-screen visuals and animations that illustrate what the speaker is talking about — if a client explains a point, you bring it to life on screen with graphics, text, and visual elements



Clean animated captions/subtitles, music, sound effects, color, and our branding



Sourcing your own B-roll and stock footage — pulling visuals from the client’s website, Google, and stock libraries to make the edit stronger (you don’t just wait for footage, you find what the video needs)



Cutting for retention — strong hook in the first 2 seconds, tight pacing, a CTA on every video

Occasionally some long-form editing (rare, but it comes up)



Following a simple brief for each client (we give you the hook, the vibe, the CTA)

Delivering batches consistently and on time





What I’m looking for (read carefully):



Consistency — the same high quality on video #1 and video #30. This matters most.

Communication — you reply, you ask when unclear, you update me. I will not chase you.

Strong English — you clearly understand direction and communicate back without confusion.

Strong visual animation + text skills — this is core, not a bonus. You can make on screen graphics that explain a point, not just slap captions on.

Resourcefulness — you can go find B-roll and stock footage on your own to elevate a video.

Software: strong in Adobe Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve (After Effects a big plus). CapCut is okay only if your output genuinely looks high-quality — but I lean toward editors working in Adobe or DaVinci.

A real eye for what’s working on IG/TikTok right now — pacing, transitions, text styling

Handles volume (~30+ videos/month per client) without quality slipping

Reliable internet and your own editing setup





Logistics — read this, because it matters:



- Base rate: $6.50/hr, part time to start, flexible hours based on workload

This isn’t some far off reward you wait months for. Show up when it counts and the extra money comes quick.



- There is no ceiling on this role. I mean that. If you’re consistent and crushing it, I will take care of you above and beyond — more hours, more pay, more bonuses, and a real spot on a growing team. The right editor grows with this agency, not under it.



- Most of the specifics (workflow, growth path, how we’ll work together) we’ll cover on a call — this post is step one.





How to apply — follow these exactly (this is part of the test):



1. Start your message with the word “GROWTH” so I know you read the whole post.

2. Send 2–3 examples of short-form videos you’ve edited (links).

3. In one or two sentences, tell me what makes a short-form video keep someone watching.

4. Best contact information



Applications that don’t follow all three steps won’t be considered.

title: Hiring Facebook Ads Static Designer (Ecommerce/DTC) – Long-Term Opportunity!
description:
Hiring
 Ads Static Designer (Ecommerce/DTC) – Long-Term Opportunity!



Mivourr is looking for a Performance Graphic Designer to join our team! You will be responsible for designing high-converting static ads at volume for our paid marketing channels, with a big focus on Meta.



We are looking to hire someone with 2+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience designing paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience in health, beauty or wellness brands.



Who are we?

At Mivourr, we are dedicated to improving women’s lives by tackling a problem that’s rarely talked about: vaginal dryness and painful intimacy. Our hero product, vGlow, is an intimate red light therapy device that helps women feel comfortable and confident again. Since our launch, we have grown rapidly through performance marketing, selling worldwide with most customers in the US, Australia, UK and Canada. We operate with a small but mighty team focused on speed and continuous growth, and we’re excited to bring on a graphic designer to play a pivotal role in scaling our creative output even further.



What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following core values: “work smart”, “overdeliver”, “speed is king” and “better everyday”. We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn’t it.



If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a huge role in scaling it. Drive results with a small team of passionate, smart & hardworking people. Work in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance, then you have come to the right place.



Key Objectives:

- Research winning static ads in our market (Meta Ad Library, competitors) and recreate and improve them for our brand

- Turn ad concepts, copy and product photos into scroll-stopping static ads for Meta

- Expand our proven static concepts into new angles, formats and visual styles to keep testing fresh

- Work closely with the founder to keep a consistent look across all creatives

- Drive measurable improvements in core ad metrics (CTR, CPA) using Meta performance data to guide every new design



Requirements:

- Fully remote, with reliable internet

- Fluent in English, with some daily overlap with European time zones

- Direct Response Expertise: 2+ years designing performance static ads for ecommerce/dropshipping brands or at a creative agency is a must

- Tools: Proficiency in Photoshop and/or Figma, plus AI image tools like Midjourney, ChatGPT or similar

- Strong eye for ad formats that convert: before/after, testimonials, us vs. them, listicles, native-style and social proof ads

- Solid copy sense: you know how to make a headline pop and keep text short and readable on mobile

- Ability to create product mockups and lifestyle visuals when we don’t have the right photo

- Fast and organized: you can keep quality high while working at volume under tight deadlines

- You take feedback well and turn it around quickly, without ego

- Comfortable working with women’s health and intimacy topics in a tasteful, educational way

- Excellent cultural fit as per our values above



Accountabilities:

- Produce a high volume of static ads every week using AI tools, mixing two types of work:

    - Competitor ad adaptations: recreate proven static ads from our swipe library for our product

    - New concepts: design original static ads to test new angles, with multiple variations each (usually different headlines or visuals)

- Use AI to speed up production without sacrificing quality: every ad must look polished, on-brand and ready to launch

- Export every ad in the right size (1:1, 4:5 or 9:16) with our naming convention, ready to launch

- Retouch and prepare product photos and visuals for ads, landing pages and
 when needed

- Keep our design files and brand assets organized in a shared library

- Turn around feedback and revisions within 24 hours



How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate:

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.



Initial screening of your portfolio, then a trial project where you’ll design a set of test static ads for our product, and a final interview with the founder to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8-10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.



For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!



To apply, send your portfolio with as many static ads as possible that you’ve designed, ideally from the last 6 months (performance data is a big plus), and start your application with the word “Wizard” so we know you read the full post (ONLY applications with a strong ecommerce ads portfolio will be accepted).



Salary Expectation:

USD $1500 to $2500 per month + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

title: Accounting Manager / Controller (U.S. Accounting)
description:
Accounting Manager / Controller (U.S. Accounting)

Full-Time | Remote, Philippines | Long-Term Career Opportunity

Salary: Competitive, based on experience and qualifications

Schedule: Flexible, with availability for meetings with our U.S. team



About Our Company



Promofect is a growing U.S.-based company with approximately $2+ million in annual revenue. We specialize in custom branded apparel, promotional products, and online merchandise stores.



We operate through two brands, Promofect and New York Rush Shirts, serving customers ranging from small businesses to large organizations. Our business combines B2B sales, e-commerce, in-house production, and outsourced manufacturing.



We're looking for an experienced accounting professional who can take ownership of our accounting operations, improve our financial systems, and help us build a stronger foundation for continued growth.



About the Opportunity



Currently, our accounting and finance functions are managed directly by the company owner, who has a professional background in accounting and finance.



We're looking for someone who can take over the day-to-day accounting responsibilities, maintain accurate financial records, develop better reporting, and continuously improve our processes.



The owner will continue overseeing higher-level financial strategy, but we want someone who can independently manage the accounting function without requiring constant supervision or technical accounting guidance.



We can teach you our business. We expect you to already know accounting.



We're not a large corporation with separate departments for every function. At our current size, this position requires someone comfortable wearing multiple hats, handling both detailed accounting work and broader financial projects.



As the company grows, some responsibilities may transition to additional team members. The right candidate will have the opportunity to help build the systems, procedures, and team that support a much larger business.



Key Responsibilities



1. Accounting & Financial Operations



• Take ownership of our daily accounting operations using QuickBooks Online.

• Manage transaction categorization, accounts payable, and accounts receivable.

• Oversee 
, vendor payments, invoicing, and collections.

• Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, payment processors, and transactions from our various sales platforms.

• Manage month-end closing and maintain accurate financial statements in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

• Maintain accurate general ledger records and proper accrual accounting.

• Review existing accounting processes, identify errors or inefficiencies, and make improvements.

• Maintain strong financial controls and organized supporting documentation.



2. Financial Reporting & Analysis



• Prepare accurate daily sales and revenue reports across our different business channels.

• Maintain financial reports, dashboards, and management reporting.

• Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and budget-versus-actual analysis.

• Monitor cash flow, upcoming payments, and financial obligations.

• Develop reporting that helps us understand profitability by customer, order, product category, and business segment.

• Analyze order costs, including products, outsourced manufacturing, in-house production, and shipping.

• Work with management to improve our pricing models using actual financial results.

• Help connect revenue and profitability reporting with sales and marketing data.



3. Tax Compliance & Financial Administration



We have outside U.S. CPAs and tax professionals who handle our business income tax returns and provide specialized tax advice. You will coordinate with these professionals rather than replace them.



Responsibilities include:



• Manage ongoing sales tax reporting and filing processes across applicable U.S. states.

• Help maintain and improve sales tax compliance as the company grows.

• Recognize potential compliance issues and coordinate with outside advisors when needed.

• Manage W-9 collection and 1099 preparation and filing.

• Maintain accurate reporting for customer revenue-sharing programs and related payouts.

• Coordinate with outside accountants and tax professionals to ensure accurate and timely reporting.



4. Systems, Technology & Automation



We use several software platforms, including:



• QuickBooks Online

• 

• Printavo

• InkSoft

• Chipply



Some of these platforms support e-commerce and online merchandise stores, making accurate reconciliation and consolidated reporting especially important.



We want someone who is comfortable with technology and enthusiastic about improving processes.



Responsibilities include:



• Identify accounting tasks that can be simplified or automated.

• Use AI, automation tools, and software integrations to improve reporting, accuracy, and efficiency.

• Improve the flow of financial information between our systems.

• Build reliable, repeatable processes that reduce manual work.

• Continuously suggest and implement practical improvements.



Advanced AI development experience is not required. However, we expect you to already be using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude in your day-to-day accounting work, and to bring curiosity, strong technical aptitude, and a forward-looking approach to modern tools.



5. Payroll & Administrative Support



As a growing company, we also need flexibility across certain administrative and HR-related responsibilities.



You'll work alongside existing team members to help oversee:



• Employee time tracking and payroll processing.

• Sales commissions, bonuses, and incentive calculations.

• Payroll-related reconciliations and records.

• Employee administrative records and important milestones.

• Other finance-related administrative processes as needed.



These responsibilities may evolve or be delegated as the company grows.



Required Qualifications



• At least 5 years of professional accounting experience, including significant experience working with U.S.-based businesses.

• A stable career history, including at least 3 years in a single in-house role where you held real responsibility for a company's accounting (not freelance or multi-client bookkeeping).

• Active, hands-on use of AI tools in your current accounting work.

• Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and accrual accounting.

• Advanced QuickBooks Online experience.

• Proven ability to independently manage full-cycle accounting and monthly closing.

• Experience preparing accurate financial statements and performing account reconciliations.

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Strong attention to detail, accountability, and organizational skills.

• Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and make sound accounting decisions.



Preferred, but Not Required



• Experience as an Accounting Manager, Controller, Assistant Controller, or senior accountant with broad responsibilities.

• Experience in e-commerce, distribution, manufacturing, or order-based businesses.

• Experience with cost accounting, job costing, budgeting, and financial analysis.

• Familiarity with U.S. sales tax compliance.

• Experience with AI, automation, reporting tools, or software integrations.

• Experience improving accounting systems for a growing small business.

• Previous experience supervising or training accounting staff.



A CPA qualification is not required. Demonstrated accounting competence and real-world experience are more important to us.



Who We're Looking For



The right person is an experienced accounting professional who enjoys taking ownership and improving the way things work.



We're looking for longevity. You've held an important accounting role within one company for several years, grew with that business, and were trusted with real responsibility. If your experience is mainly freelance work or outsourced bookkeeping across many small clients, this role is likely not the right fit.



You're forward-looking. You think ahead, anticipate problems before they happen, plan for growth, and already use AI and modern tools to work smarter.



You're comfortable handling everyday accounting transactions, but you also enjoy analyzing financial information, building better reports, and finding opportunities to improve the business.



You don't need to be an expert in every area of finance, technology, or tax. You do need to be resourceful, understand your responsibilities, recognize when specialized advice is needed, and take initiative to get things done.



We're especially interested in someone who has worked in a growing business and understands the need to balance day-to-day responsibilities with building better systems for the future.



We value independent thinking, accuracy, reliability, efficiency, and a willingness to continuously improve.



Growth Opportunity



This position will initially report directly to the company owner.



Our goal is to develop an organized, accurate, and efficient accounting function that can support the company as it grows.



Over time, you may have the opportunity to supervise additional accounting staff and take on broader responsibilities.



As the company expands, we may eventually introduce additional senior financial leadership. Our goal is for this position to remain an important part of a strong and scalable finance department.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow their career with us and become a valued, long-term member of our team.



This is a full-time position dedicated to our company, not a freelance opportunity. We're looking for someone ready to commit to one company for the long term.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume and answer the following questions. We're looking for specific examples from your actual professional experience rather than generic responses.



1. Accounting Experience

Describe your experience managing accounting for U.S.-based companies. Have you independently handled the full accounting cycle, including monthly closing and financial statements?



2. Ownership & Problem-Solving

Tell us about a time you took over an accounting function, discovered problems, or improved existing processes. What did you personally accomplish?



3. Financial Reporting & Analysis

Describe your experience with budgeting, financial reporting, job costing, or profitability analysis. Have you built reports that helped management make better financial decisions?



4. Technology & Automation

Which AI tools do you use in your accounting work today, and how? Share a specific example of how AI, automation, or other technology improved an accounting process.



5. Working in a Growing Business

Are you comfortable being hands-on with daily accounting while also helping with payroll, reporting, and other administrative responsibilities as needed? Describe any similar experience.



6. Career Stability

What is the longest role you've held at a single company? How long were you there, what was your title, and what were you responsible for?



7. Compensation & Availability

What is your expected monthly salary in USD, and when would you be available to start?



We're looking for someone who can take ownership, deliver accurate work, improve our processes, and grow with our company. Qualified finalists may be asked to complete a paid practical accounting assessment.

title: AI-Savvy Service Delivery Specialist - Claude / ChatGPT / Codex (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
We run an online service business that helps people recover, grow and protect their Instagram and social media accounts. Customers order through our app, and every order is delivered by our team using clear step-by-step SOPs inside our own CRM.



*** THIS IS A SERVICE DELIVERY ROLE FOR SOMEONE WHO IS GENUINELY STRONG WITH AI ***

The day-to-day job is simple once you are trained: you fulfil customer orders by following our SOPs. But our whole operation runs on AI tools and our own software, so we need someone properly technical - more on the developer side than a general VA.



You must be very good with:

- Claude and ChatGPT - using BOTH every day for real work, not just for writing messages

- Claude Code, Codex or similar AI coding tools

- Picking up new software fast and following a process exactly

If AI is not already one of your strongest skills, please do not apply.



WHAT YOU WOULD BE DOING

- Fulfilling service-delivery orders in our CRM and app, step by step from our SOPs

- Messaging suppliers and customers to keep each order moving

- Handling support tickets and keeping order statuses up to date

- Spotting when something (or our AI) is wrong and flagging it straight away

- Clocking in and out, and writing a short end-of-shift handover



WE WANT SOMEONE WHO WILL CHALLENGE ME

I do not want someone who just agrees with everything. If something in a process is wrong or slow, tell me and suggest a better way.



EXCELLENT ENGLISH - WRITTEN AND SPOKEN

You will write to customers and suppliers every day. Clear, natural English is a must.



THE DETAILS

- Pay: $4 USD per hour + weekly performance bonus

- Hours: minimum 8 hours a day, 6 days a week (afternoon/evening Philippine time). We are ideally looking for someone who can work up to 12 hours a day - the more hours you can reliably work, the more you earn

- Full-time, remote, long-term

- Time tracking and screen sharing during shifts

- Pay reviews at 3, 6 and 12 months



HOW TO APPLY - PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



Please do not send a generic CV or a cover letter written by AI. We can tell, and it is an instant no - partly because this job is about spotting AI output.



Answer all 11 points below, in this order. Applications that skip any point will not be read.



1. Start your application with the words HUMAN CHECK so we know you read this properly.



2. YOUR LAST RELEVANT JOB: where, how long, and what you actually did day to day. Include how many orders, customers or tickets you handled per day, and which tools you used. Include any technical, developer or operations experience too. If you have no support or delivery experience, say so plainly - willingness to learn is fine, but be honest.



3. TELL US ABOUT A REAL TIME YOU CAUGHT A MISTAKE BY A COLLEAGUE OR DISAGREED WITH YOUR BOSS - what it was, how you noticed, what you said or did, and what happened. One short paragraph. Please give a real example, not a general statement.



4. READ THIS MESSAGE that an AI assistant sent to a real customer, and tell us what is wrong with it:



   Hi! Good news, we are sending the login request to your phone again right now and our team is actively working on your account as we speak. You should see it come through in the next few minutes. We will have this fully resolved for you today, guaranteed!



The truth at that time: nothing was running, nobody was working on the account, and we had no idea when it would be resolved.



In your own words: what is wrong here, and why does it matter? (3-4 sentences)



5. A customer writes: this is taking forever, I want a refund. Our policy is that we do not give refunds - we fix the problem or replace the account. Write the exact reply you would send back to this customer.



6. You notice our AI has sent the same customer almost the same message 8 times in one night. What do you do, and in what order? (2-3 sentences)



7. Confirm you can work at least 8 hours a day, 6 days a week, in the afternoon/evening Philippine time, and that you are comfortable with $4 USD per hour. Also tell us the MAXIMUM number of hours per day you can reliably work (we prefer up to 12).



8. YOUR WORK SETUP - please be specific, because we need you online for the whole shift:

   - Your internet provider and your actual speed (a speed test screenshot is ideal)

   - Your backup if the internet goes down (mobile data, pocket wifi, a second provider?)

   - How often your area has brownouts, and what you do if the power goes out mid-shift (UPS, power bank, generator, a cafe nearby?)

   - Your computer (make and rough age), and whether you have a quiet place to work



Please be honest here. We would much rather know about a weekly brownout up front than discover it in week two. Having a backup plan matters more to us than having perfect conditions.



9. YOUR AI SKILLS - two parts:

   a) Which AI tools and models you use (we especially want Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code and Codex), how often, the newest AI model or tool you have tried in the last month and what you thought of it, and the most technical thing you have done with AI (a custom GPT, an AI agent, an automation, an API integration, code you built with AI). Be specific - links or screenshots are welcome.

   b) Our AI assistant (question 4 above) keeps telling customers their order is being worked on right now and will be done today, guaranteed - when it has no way of knowing that. Write the exact instruction you would add to its system prompt to stop it, and explain in 1-2 sentences why the AI does this in the first place.



10. Your CV or OnlineJobs profile, plus one sentence on which part of it is most relevant to this specific job.



11. A 60-90 SECOND VOICE RECORDING in English (a Vocaroo, Google Drive or similar link). Unscripted: tell us about one AI tool you use every day and one thing you think most businesses get wrong about AI.



Everyone who follows all 11 steps gets a reply. Shortlisted candidates get a short paid test task before any interview.
