title: After Hours Dispatch Lead (Asset Operations)
description:
AJG Transport is expanding its asset operations division and seeking an experienced, dependable, and results-driven After Hours Dispatch Lead (Asset Operations) to oversee our overnight trucking operations.



We are looking for a hands-on operations leader who can manage fleet movements, coordinate driver dispatches, resolve operational issues, and lead a remote fleet management team (FMT). This role requires strong US trucking experience, sound operational judgment, and the ability to take full ownership of night operations in a fast-paced environment.



Role Overview

You will serve as the primary operational lead during the night shift, overseeing active trucks, drivers, trailers, and a team of approximately 5–8 remote associates. Your responsibility is to ensure every load is properly assigned, dispatched, tracked, and completed while proactively resolving breakdowns, delays, equipment issues, and service risks.



This is a hands-on leadership role, not solely a coordination or administrative position. You will be expected to make timely operational decisions, hold your team accountable, and ensure a smooth transition to the day shift.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Oversee night asset operations, monitoring truck movements, driver availability, trailer assignments, and scheduled pickups and deliveries.

• Lead and support a remote team of 5–8 associates, managing workload distribution, shift coverage, performance, and accountability.

• Coordinate driver dispatches, verify equipment assignments, conduct structured check calls, and ensure drivers receive clear instructions before scheduled movements.

• Monitor real-time fleet activity using GPS tracking systems and other operational platforms while maintaining accurate dispatch records.

• Investigate and resolve overnight operational issues, including breakdowns, roadside emergencies, route delays, equipment shortages, and missed appointments.

• Coordinate with maintenance, brokerage, and load planning teams to recover loads, arrange equipment solutions, and minimize service disruptions.

• Conduct scheduled tracking audits, maintain accurate operational reports, escalate critical risks, and prepare detailed shift handoffs.

• Identify recurring operational issues, recommend process improvements, and reinforce established SOPs across the team.



What Success Looks Like

• Maintain full visibility and operational control over active trucks, drivers, and trailers throughout the night shift.

• Ensure loads are dispatched on time, with minimal delays, missed appointments, or preventable service failures.

• Resolve operational problems proactively instead of allowing unresolved issues to carry over to the next shift.

• Maintain accurate, up-to-date information across tracking systems, dispatch records, and performance reports.

• Build a reliable and accountable night team that consistently meets operational expectations.

• Deliver clear, organized shift handoffs with documented issues, actions taken, and outstanding priorities.



Who We’re Looking For

• At least 3 years of direct US trucking operations experience in dispatch, fleet management, load coordination, carrier operations, or similar roles.

• At least 1 year of team leadership or supervisory experience, including workload management, performance coaching, and accountability.

• Hands-on experience using GPS and fleet visibility platforms or comparable systems.

• Strong understanding of US trucking operations, driver dispatch, Hours of Service (HOS), equipment coordination, and time-sensitive freight movements.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to provide structured, concise, and actionable operational updates.

• Strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to make independent decisions under pressure.

• Highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple operational priorities simultaneously.

• Team-oriented, coachable, and dependable, with a strong ownership mindset and willingness to hold themselves and others accountable.

• Must have a reliable backup internet connection and backup power source to maintain operational continuity.

• Experience with government freight operations, fleet repair system, TMS, fuel card system, or freight recovery is an advantage. Spanish proficiency is a plus for Mexico-based applicants.



Why Join GH Logistics?

• Permanent remote opportunity with a stable, long-term setup.

• $75 monthly stipend (eligible after working for 30 days)

• Competitive hourly compensation based on location and experience.

• Hands-on leadership role with direct responsibility for operational performance.

• Structured systems, clear expectations, and defined performance KPIs.

• Direct collaboration with US-based operations leadership.

• Opportunities to improve processes, strengthen team performance, and take on greater operational responsibilities.

• Performance recognition with growth potential for strong contributors.



Schedule & Work Setup

• Direct hire and full-time position with a US-based trucking company and permanent work-from-home setup.

• Shift: Approximately 3:00 PM – 1:00 AM US Central Time, with flexibility to extend as operationally required. 

• Workdays: Includes weekends; this is not a standard Monday–Friday schedule. To be finalized during hiring

• Active participation in Zoom for remote operational communication and collaboration is required throughout the shift.

• Time-tracking software is used for accountability and performance monitoring.

• Reliable primary internet, backup internet, and backup power are mandatory.



If you have strong US trucking experience, know how to lead a team under pressure, and can take ownership of overnight fleet operations without waiting for instructions, we want to hear from you.

title: Project Manager and assistant
description:
Solar Project Manager & Executive Assistant



Department: Solar Operations & Sales Support

Reports To: Regional Manager / Enterprise Owner

Position Type: Full-Time

Industry: Residential Solar Energy



Position Overview



We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Solar Project Manager & Executive Assistant to oversee our residential solar projects from the point of sale through installation, activation, and completion.



This individual will also serve as the direct assistant to the Regional Manager, helping manage daily operations, coordinate with sales representatives, communicate with homeowners, and ensure projects move efficiently through every stage.



The primary goal of this position is to keep solar projects moving, prevent unnecessary delays, support our sales team, and free up the Regional Manager to focus on recruiting, sales, leadership, and business growth.



The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership, solves problems independently, communicates effectively, and can manage multiple projects simultaneously.



Key Responsibilities



1. Solar Project Management



Manage all residential solar projects from signed agreement through installation and Permission to Operate (PTO).



Track every project through the solar installation pipeline.



Monitor site surveys, engineering, design approvals, permitting, installation scheduling, inspections, and utility approvals.



Coordinate with EPC partners, installers, and internal operations departments.



Identify projects experiencing delays and proactively work toward resolutions.



Follow up on missing documents, signatures, utility bills, and homeowner requirements.



Maintain accurate project statuses and estimated completion dates.



Escalate urgent project issues to the Regional Manager.



Ensure projects are progressing toward installation and activation as efficiently as possible.



2. Sales Team Support



Serve as the primary operations contact for solar sales representatives.



Provide updates to setters and closers regarding their customers' projects.



Assist representatives with submitting complete and accurate project documentation.



Track deals submitted, approved, installed, canceled, and pending.



Follow up on outstanding project requirements that could delay installation.



Help resolve project-related issues affecting the sales team's commissions.



Coordinate with sales representatives to ensure smooth handoffs after contracts are signed.



Maintain organized records of projects associated with each representative.



3. Executive Assistant Responsibilities



Provide direct administrative and operational support to the Regional Manager.



Manage calendars, meetings, appointments, and important deadlines.



Organize daily priorities and follow-up tasks.



Prepare reports, spreadsheets, and operational summaries.



Assist with internal communication between leadership, sales representatives, and operations.



Help organize sales meetings, training sessions, and team events.



Maintain organized digital files, contracts, and company records.



Follow up with individuals or departments on behalf of the Regional Manager.



Handle confidential business and team information professionally.



4. Customer Communication & Experience



Maintain professional communication with homeowners throughout the solar installation process.



Provide project updates and explain next steps when necessary.



Follow up with homeowners regarding scheduling, documents, and project requirements.



Help resolve customer concerns by coordinating with the appropriate departments.



Ensure homeowners receive timely updates when project milestones change.



Assist in preventing cancellations caused by poor communication or unnecessary delays.



Escalate contractual, technical, or financing concerns to authorized personnel.



5. CRM & Project Tracking



Maintain accurate and updated information in the company's CRM and solar project management platforms.



Create and maintain a master project tracking spreadsheet.



Track important project information, including:



Customer name and project identification number



Setter and closer assigned



Date of sale



System size and equipment



Finance or PPA provider



Project status



Site survey and permitting status



Installation date



PTO status



Commission status



Ensure information is updated consistently and accurately.



Identify stalled projects and prioritize follow-ups.



6. Commission & Installation Tracking



Monitor completed installations and project milestones relevant to commission eligibility.



Maintain accurate installation records for each sales representative.



Coordinate with accounting or commission departments regarding outstanding payments.



Track pending commissions, payment statuses, and discrepancies.



Notify the Regional Manager of projects with commission issues.



Prepare weekly installation and commission tracking reports.



This position tracks and reconciles commission information but does not independently authorize payments.



Daily Responsibilities



Each workday, the Project Manager & Executive Assistant will:



Review all active solar projects and identify urgent issues.



Follow up with EPC partners and operations teams on delayed projects.



Update the master project tracker and CRM.



Communicate important project updates to sales representatives.



Contact homeowners when documentation or scheduling is required.



Review upcoming installations, inspections, and PTO milestones.



Assist the Regional Manager with meetings, schedules, and administrative priorities.



Provide an end-of-day summary of completed tasks, project progress, and unresolved issues.



Weekly Responsibilities



Prepare a weekly solar project pipeline report.



Report total active projects, installations, cancellations, and projects awaiting PTO.



Identify stalled projects and explain the reason for each delay.



Review outstanding documentation and permitting issues.



Track installations and pending commissions by sales representative.



Attend weekly operations meetings with the Regional Manager.



Recommend process improvements to reduce project delays.



Qualifications



Required:



Strong organizational and time-management skills.



Excellent written and verbal communication.



Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.



Experience with CRM systems, spreadsheets, and administrative software.



Strong attention to detail and follow-through.



Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



Professional customer service and problem-solving skills.



Comfortable communicating with sales teams, customers, and business partners.



Preferred:



Previous experience in residential solar operations or project management.



Understanding of solar project stages, including site surveys, permitting, installation, inspections, and PTO.



Experience working with EPC partners and solar financing or PPA programs.



Experience using platforms such as Powur, HighLevel, Google Workspace, or similar systems.



Experience supporting a sales manager, regional manager, or business owner.



Familiarity with California residential solar processes.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Performance will be evaluated using the following metrics:



KPI



Performance Expectation



Project Tracking



100% of active projects accurately tracked



CRM Updates



Updated every business day



Project Follow-Ups



No active project left without a documented next step



Sales Rep Communication



Respond to routine inquiries within 1 business day



Delayed Projects



Identify and escalate issues promptly



Weekly Reporting



Submit a complete report every week



Installation Tracking



Accurately track completed installations



Executive Support



Complete assigned priorities by agreed deadlines



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is more than just an assistant.



This person should be a problem-solver, organizer, and operations leader who takes responsibility for keeping the business running efficiently.



The right candidate will:



Take initiative without constantly needing direction.



Be comfortable holding people accountable for follow-ups.



Understand the importance of deadlines.



Communicate clearly and professionally.



Be extremely organized and dependable.



Have a sense of urgency when projects are delayed.



Protect the customer experience and the company's reputation.



Help create systems that allow the solar enterprise to scale.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role means the Regional Manager can focus on building the sales organization, recruiting, training leaders, and increasing revenue, knowing that solar projects are being actively managed.



Every project should have a clear status, an assigned next step, and consistent follow-through.



The ultimate objective is to increase installation efficiency, reduce cancellations, improve customer satisfaction, and build a more organized and profitable solar operation.

title: Direct Response AI Video Editor - Meta ads
description:
We're looking for a highly creative, hungry, and experienced Direct Response AI Video Editor to join our team full-time and produce high-performing
 & Instagram ads for our fast-growing DTC eCommerce brand.



This is NOT a basic video editing role. We need someone who understands direct-response marketing, storytelling, attention-grabbing hooks, pacing, and what makes people buy.



What You'll Be Doing

- Turn provided scripts and creative briefs into complete, high-quality video ads.

- Generating any footage required with AI tools

- Handle the entire production process: AI generation, editing, B-roll, sound design, transitions, captions, and final delivery.

- Bring your own creative ideas to improve storytelling, visuals, and overall ad quality.

- Produce multiple ad creatives consistently while maintaining high quality.



Types of Ads We Produce

- AI Cartoon & Animated Ads

- Song Ads

- VSLs

- UGC Ads

- Other Creative Formats



Requirements

- Proven experience editing direct-response Meta ads for DTC/eCommerce brands.

- Strong experience with AI video and image generation tools.

- Excellent understanding of hooks, pacing, storytelling, retention, and sound design.

- Strong creativity and ability to execute ideas without constant guidance.

- Good English communication skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to follow detailed briefs while independently solving creative problems.



What We're Looking For

Someone who doesn't just follow instructions but actually understands what makes a great ad. You should be able to take a script, visualize the entire concept, and turn it into a polished, engaging video without needing to be guided through every step.



If you think this is for you, send your portfolio with examples of direct-response ads you've personally created, especially AI-generated ads. Applications without relevant work samples will not be considered.

description:

Growthzilla is a performance marketing agency. We run paid ads and funnels for clients in coaching, education, finance and professional services, and we are growing. You will work across several client accounts, each with its own offer, audience and brand voice, so you need to switch styles fast without losing the direct-response fundamentals.

, Instagram and TikTok, plus long-form YouTube

s, spreadsheets, reports, and operational systems and determine routine next steps.

 marketing

ABOUT TÀBERG FALLS



Tàberg Falls Private Villas is a luxury resort of glass villas for couples, located on a river with a waterfall in Taberg, New York, at the gateway to the Adirondacks.



We opened in summer 2026, book direct with our guests, and have grown our Instagram audience to approximately 28,000 followers.

The right person may eventually have the opportunity to build and lead a small marketing and content team as Tàberg Falls expands.





THE CREATIVE DIRECTION



Tàberg Falls is visually beautiful, but we do not want our social media to feel like a catalog of property photos.



We want to increasingly show real couples genuinely experiencing Tàberg Falls in a way that feels romantic, natural, believable, and human.



We want content that helps people imagine what it would feel like to stay here with someone they love.



Beautiful photography and editing matter, but the finished content should not feel artificial, overly produced, or AI-generated.



Real people, real moments, and real experiences should be at the center of the brand.



Authenticity is one of the core principles of the marketing we are building. We want people to trust what they see and feel that the experience we are showing is real.



We are looking for someone who can bring their own creativity and point of view to that direction while protecting the authenticity and trust we want the brand to communicate.





WHO WE’RE MARKETING TO



Our primary audience is established couples ages 30–60, primarily from greater NYC, Connecticut, Northern New Jersey, Buffalo, Rochester, Syracuse, Utica, and surrounding markets.



They are often busy professionals or business owners looking to disconnect from demanding lives and reconnect with each other.



Our goal is qualified audience growth that leads to direct bookings. Our broader marketing objective is to help drive Tàberg Falls toward 80%+ occupancy while maintaining or improving ADR.

- Turn raw footage into Reels, Stories, carousels, posts, and ads

Responsibilities may include building and managing Meta campaigns, testing creative and audiences, monitoring performance, developing retargeting campaigns, improving conversion tracking, and keeping the focus on direct bookings and measurable return.



Experience with Meta Pixel, retargeting, and conversion tracking is a strong advantage.





CREATOR & MEDIA MANAGEMENT



You will help vet and recommend creators, coordinate stays, provide creative direction, collect raw footage, and identify creators worth working with again. Leadership gives final approval on partnerships.



You will also own our Google Drive media library. Our team should be able to upload raw, unorganized footage without sorting it first. You will review it, identify the strongest usable content, prepare B-roll, preserve originals, and keep everything organized and searchable.





COPYWRITING,
 & WEBSITE SKILLS

 marketing through GoHighLevel is a supporting part of the role.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



Required:



- Proven social media marketing experience

- Strong short-form video editing

- Strong understanding of Instagram and

- Excellent written English

- Strong creative judgment, organization, and attention to detail

- Meta Pixel, retargeting, or conversion-tracking experience

Hospitality, travel, lifestyle, luxury, tourism, or consumer-brand experience is a plus.





SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION

WATERFALL

 or website examples, if available.

If you became responsible for our marketing tomorrow, what is one thing you would improve during your first 30 days, and why?

title: Part Time Reaction Video Editor
description:
## Editing Responsibilities



- Edit talking-head news commentary and reaction videos.

- Remove mistakes, unnecessary pauses, and dead space.

- Maintain natural conversational pacing.

- Perform basic audio cleanup and volume leveling.

- Incorporate relevant news clips, screenshots, and supporting footage.

- Keep B-roll to approximately **15–20% maximum** of the finished video.

- Add occasional on-screen headlines, text, and simple graphics.

- Deliver polished, YouTube-ready videos.

- Follow established THPP News editing guidelines and maintain a consistent visual style.



## Required Editing Software



Applicants must be proficient in at least one of the following:



- **CapCut Pro**

- **Adobe Premiere Pro**

- **Final Cut Pro**

- **DaVinci Resolve**



Experience editing YouTube reaction videos, talking-head commentary, or news content is strongly preferred.



## Ideal Candidate



- Strong understanding of YouTube editing and audience retention.

- Excellent English comprehension.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Reliable computer equipment and internet connection.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to follow instructions.

- Consistent communication and dependable delivery.

- Ability to complete straightforward 8–12-minute videos within the agreed turnaround window.

- Interested in establishing a long-term working relationship.



## Compensation, 30-Day Trial & Growth Opportunities



**Phase 1: Initial 30-Day Paid Trial**



All selected editors will begin with a 30-day paid trial.



During this period:



- Compensation will be **$25 USD per completed video**.

- Expected production is approximately 3 videos per week.

- Editing quality, communication, reliability, and turnaround time will be evaluated.

- Both parties will have the opportunity to determine whether the working relationship is a good fit.



**Phase 2: Ongoing Part-Time Position**



Following a successful 30-day trial, the selected editor will transition to an ongoing part-time position.



- Monthly compensation will range from **$200–$350 USD**, depending on the mutually agreed schedule and workload.

- A consistent production schedule and expected video volume will be established before the transition.

- Additional assignments or changes in workload and compensation will be discussed and agreed upon.



**Phase 3: Channel Growth & Increased Earnings**



Our goal is to establish a long-term relationship with an editor who can grow alongside THPP News.



As the channel becomes monetized and generates increasing revenue:



- Compensation will  increase based on channel growth and performance.

- Performance-based bonuses may be introduced.

- Additional editing assignments may become available.

- Increased production responsibilities will be accompanied by corresponding increases in compensation.



We are looking for someone interested in growing with the company rather than simply completing occasional freelance projects.



## Interview & Trial Editing Test



**The interview process will include a mandatory 3–5-minute paid trial editing test with a fast turnaround requirement.**



Shortlisted candidates will receive sample THPP News footage and clear editing instructions.



The test will evaluate:



- Editing quality and professional presentation

- Ability to remove unnecessary pauses while maintaining natural pacing

- Audio quality and synchronization

- Appropriate use of minimal B-roll and supporting visuals

- Ability to follow specific editing instructions

- **Speed, efficiency, and turnaround time**



Candidates should be prepared to complete the test promptly within an agreed time window.



Fast turnaround is an essential requirement because our content frequently covers developing news and current events.



## How to Apply



Please submit the following information:



1. **Portfolio:** Links to at least two YouTube videos you have edited, preferably reaction, news, or commentary content.

2. **Editing Software:** Which of the approved editing platforms do you use?

3. **Availability:** Your typical working hours in Philippine Standard Time.

4. **Turnaround:** Can you consistently complete an 8–12-minute reaction video within 2–4 hours?

5. **Compensation:** Confirm your acceptance of the $25-per-video initial trial rate and the proposed part-time compensation structure.

6. **Experience:** Briefly describe your experience editing YouTube content.

7. **Editing Test:** Confirm your willingness to complete a paid 3–5-minute trial editing assignment with a fast turnaround.



We are seeking a dependable, skilled editor who values consistency, efficiency, and professional growth.



**THPP Network Studios**\

*THPP News — News, Current Events & Social Commentary*

- Look for smaller creators (under 50,000 followers) who fit our brand and are easy to work with and coach

- Follow up with creators who reply until they book a call with us

- We review your list with you, so you get better fast



Hours and pay

- $5/hour, long-term (about $390 a month)

- About 3 hours a day, 6 days a week, with a target of about 100 new creators messaged a day

- Fully remote



Setup (important: you need a U.S. feed)

TikTok shows you creators from the country your phone is in, so you'll need a U.S. feed:

- A phone with no SIM card and location services off

- A U.S. VPN turned on before TikTok is installed

- Create the account, then confirm your For You page shows U.S. creators on day one



What makes a great creator (they don't need all of these, just some)

- Based in the US

- Repeats a format and gets better at it over time

- Conventionally attractive

- Really good speaking voice: clear, standard American English

- Posts consistently

- Does not call themselves a "UGC creator"

- Seems "willing to work with us" - not TOO creative

- Bonus: already into self-improvement (self help, getting stronger, giving advice). We'll train you on which niches fit and what our product does

- The more undiscovered, the better: a big gap between how good they could be and how few people have found them



You're a fit if you

- Write clear, natural English

- Already spend time on TikTok/Instagram and know good content when you see it

- Pay attention to detail and can take feedback

- Can work reliably 6 days a week



To apply, send us

- 3 U.S. creators you think are a great fit, with a line on why

- Whether you can set up a U.S. VPN

- How many hours a week you can work

- Whether you can start right away

- Your phone number (WhatsApp or iMessage)



We'll start with a short paid trial and keep the people whose lists are strongest.

title: Senior AI Automation & Business Systems Lead
description:
AI Automation & Business Systems Lead





We are looking for a proactive technical leader to help us build a more organized, efficient, and automated company.



You will work directly with ownership and department leaders to understand how the business operates, identify unnecessary manual work, improve processes, and implement reliable AI tools and automations.

A major priority is developing and improving our Hermes bots and internal AI workflows using tools such as Codex and Claude Code. You will own projects from discovery and development through testing, documentation, employee training, and ongoing maintenance.



We want someone who asks good questions, identifies problems early, recommends solutions, and follows through without needing constant direction.



Compensation and working arrangement

- Up to $30 USD/hour, depending on demonstrated experience.

- Remote, with international applicants welcome.

- Intended as a long-term working relationship, beginning with a paid trial.

- Weekly hours agreed before starting.

- Must have reliable availability overlapping with U.S. Central business hours for meetings and collaboration.



What you will own

1. Work with departments to improve how the company operates

Meet with department leaders and employees to understand their workflows, tools, bottlenecks, and recurring problems.

Map processes across sales, customer service, operations, recruiting, onboarding, finance, and management.

Identify duplicate work, missed handoffs, inconsistent information, and tasks that can be simplified or automated.

Turn business needs into clear project requirements, priorities, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

Recommend process improvements before automating an inefficient process.



2. Build and maintain AI bots and automations

Audit our existing Hermes bots, integrations, and workflows; identify reliability gaps and opportunities for improvement.

Use Codex and Claude Code effectively to develop, troubleshoot, test, and maintain solutions.

Connect business tools through APIs, webhooks, scripts, and automation platforms where appropriate.

Build workflows for tasks such as reporting, task routing, follow-up tracking, data synchronization, onboarding, and internal knowledge retrieval.

D
 when to use AI and when a straightforward rule or integration will be more dependable.

Monitor deployed systems, fix failures, and improve performance over time.



3. Build our systems, processes, and SOPs

Establish an organized central knowledge base with clear document ownership and naming conventions.

Write practical SOPs, process maps, checklists, troubleshooting guides, and short training videos.

Document how systems connect, where information comes from, and which tools serve as the source of truth.

Define responsibilities, handoffs, escalation paths, and completion standards with department leaders.

Maintain an inventory of bots, automations, software subscriptions, integrations, owners, and recurring costs.



4. Lead implementation and employee adoption

Run discovery meetings and explain technical ideas in clear English.

Train employees and verify that new workflows are being used correctly.

Collect feedback and improve systems based on actual usage.

Maintain a shared project backlog and provide concise weekly updates covering progress, results, blockers, and next priorities.

Coordinate outside specialists when a project requires additional expertise.



5. Make systems reliable and maintainable

Review and test AI-generated code before deployment.

Implement appropriate logging, failure alerts, retries, duplicate prevention, and recovery procedures.

Test AI outputs against representative examples and document known limitations.

Protect sensitive business and customer information through appropriate access controls and approved tools.

Establish human review for sensitive or consequential actions.

Keep code, documentation, accounts, and deployment access under company ownership so another qualified person can maintain the systems.



Required qualifications

- Demonstrated experience deploying business automations or internal software that real teams use.

- Hands-on proficiency with both Codex and Claude Code, including explaining how you verify their work.

- Strong programming ability in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.

- Experience with APIs, webhooks, authentication, databases, Git, and troubleshooting integrations.

- Experience with at least one automation platform, such as n8n, Make, or Zapier.

- Excellent spoken and written English: able to lead meetings, clarify requirements, write useful documentation, and train nontechnical employees.

- Strong project management, prioritization, and follow-through.

- Evidence that you have maintained systems after launch and handled failures.

- A proactive approach: you identify opportunities and bring recommendations rather than waiting for detailed instructions.



Helpful additional experience

Insurance, financial services, or another business handling sensitive customer information.

CRM systems, sales operations, reporting, and customer service workflows.

Internal AI assistants, knowledge bases, and document retrieval.

Process improvement, SOP development, and organizational change.

Working directly with owners and department heads at a growing company.

Direct experience with our particular Hermes implementation is helpful. Candidates with strong relevant bot and automation experience must be able to learn and assess the existing setup.



What success looks like in the first 90 days

First 30 days: Meet department leaders, audit existing tools and Hermes bots, document priority workflows, establish baseline metrics, and deliver a ranked improvement roadmap plus an initial useful improvement.



By 60 days: Deploy an agreed first group of automations, document them, train users, and establish monitoring and support procedures.



By 90 days: Demonstrate measurable improvements in selected workflows, establish a repeatable delivery process, and maintain a clear roadmap for the next quarter.



We will evaluate success through time saved, reduced errors, faster turnaround, employee adoption, system reliability, and operating cost.



How to apply

Please include:

- Your hourly rate, location, weekly availability, and overlap with U.S. Central business hours.

- A short introduction video explaining a business process you improved.

- Two relevant project examples describing the problem, your personal contribution, tools used, measurable results, and maintenance after launch. Confidential examples may be anonymized.

- How you have used Codex and Claude Code, including an example of catching an error in AI-generated work.

- An example SOP, process map, or technical document you personally created.

- Your approach to your first two weeks in this role.

- Whether you personally perform the work and whether any subcontractors would be involved.

- Finalists will complete a short paid practical assessment and discuss their work live.

title: Remote Call & Dispatch Specialist (Tree Service, US Eastern Hours)
description:
Read this first: 

This is not a script-reading call center job, and it's not for a quiet assistant who waits to be told what to do. We want someone who picks up the phone, takes control of the call, and gets the estimate on the calendar.



We're hiring 1 to 2 Tree Service Call & Dispatch Specialists. It's remote, and you'll work US Eastern Time hours.



You'll answer live calls from US homeowners and property managers who need tree work: a tree leaning over the house, a limb on the roof, a stump in the way, or just a trim before storm season. Your job is to answer fast, ask the right questions, and book the estimate before they hang up and call the next company on Google.



⚠️ Applications without the 90-second video described below will be skipped.



What you'll do every day



Answer every call live. Homeowners call the first tree company they see. If nobody answers, they call the next one. You pick up, stay friendly, and keep it moving. That means no missed calls and no "can I call you back."



Find out what the job is. You'll get the address, what kind of work they need (removal, trimming, stump grinding, storm cleanup), how big the tree is, where it sits (near the house, a fence, or power lines), whether a truck can get to it, and photos by text when possible.



Sort out what's urgent. A tree on a house after a storm is an emergency. A hedge trim next month isn't. You'll know the difference in the first 30 seconds and send it to the right person.



Book estimates. You'll put appointments on the estimators' calendars, confirm the time with the homeowner, and send a reminder so they're home when the crew shows up.



Dispatch and coordinate. You'll work with crew leads and estimators by phone and text, move appointments around when weather or a breakdown hits, and keep every customer updated so nobody is left wondering.



Follow up. You'll call and text leads who didn't book, estimates that haven't been signed, and customers who went quiet. A lot of jobs are won on the second or third touch.



Log everything. Every call, note, and booking goes into the CRM, accurately, while you're talking.



(You don't need to know trees. We'll teach you the difference between a removal and a crown reduction. We can't teach you how to stay calm and take charge.)



What you need (please don't apply if you're missing these)



Clear, easy-to-understand spoken English. Homeowners and crew leads should understand you the first time without asking you to repeat yourself.



At least 2 years on the phones in a busy, live-call job: home services (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, pest control), roadside or towing dispatch, insurance claims, logistics dispatch, or appointment setting. You're comfortable handling a steady flow of calls all shift.



A backbone. When a homeowner says "I'm just getting prices, I'll call you back," you don't fold. You stay warm, answer their questions, and book the estimate anyway. Stressed callers after a storm don't rattle you.



Quick thinking and fast typing (45+ WPM). You can work a calendar, a CRM, and a map at the same time without losing the person on the phone.



Full-time, dedicated hours. You must be sharp and available for your full assigned shift. We run two shifts that together cover 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM Eastern Time. No second job during your shift.



A real setup. A reliable computer, dual monitors, wired high-speed internet with a backup, a noise-canceling USB headset, and a quiet room.



Pay and schedule



Starting pay: $600 USD per month, paid every two weeks.

Shifts: Two shifts covering 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM Eastern Time. You'll be assigned to one.

Paid training.

How to apply



Step 1 (about 10 minutes)



Use the subject line "TREE DISPATCH – [Your Full Name]" and send only this:



A 90-second video (Google Drive, Loom, or unlisted YouTube link). Look at the camera, not a script, and cover:



Part A (30 sec): Who you are, your toughest phone job, and how you handle a rush of calls at once.



Part B (30 sec), role-play: Pretend I'm a homeowner calling and saying, "I just need a ballpark price over the phone. I'm not having anybody come out until I know what it costs." Respond to me like it's a live call. Show us you can be friendly and still book the estimate.



Part C (30 sec): A storm just passed. Three customers are calling about trees down, and one says a limb is on their roof. Tell us out loud how you handle it and in what order.



Step 2 (only if we invite you)



A typing test, a short mock call, a screenshot of your computer specs and internet speed test, your resume, and a short live interview.

title: General Insurance Claims and Administration Officer
description:
General Insurance Claims and Administration Officer  



Remote | Philippines-Based | Monday to Friday, 9:00 am - 5:00 pm AEST



**To Apply** 



The General Insurance Claims & Administration Officer will provide claims and administrative support to a well-established general insurance broking firm in the Australian market. The role is primarily claims-focused: working under the direction of the Claims Consultant, you will help progress general insurance claims accurately and promptly through claims lodgements, insurer follow-ups, documentation requests, and record maintenance. 



Alongside claims, the role provides policy-servicing and general administrative support to the broking team to keep the brokerage running smoothly day to day. 





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



** Claims Support **  



Claims Lodgements 

- Gather and collate the required information, then lodge new general insurance claims accurately and promptly through insurer portals and systems, in accordance with the Claims Consultant’s instructions 

- Accurately record client issues, claim details, and relevant updates in the appropriate systems and CRM 



Insurer and Claims Follow-Up 

- Contact insurers, claims teams, and assessors to obtain updates on outstanding claims, including making follow-up calls and remaining on hold as required to confirm claim status, outstanding requirements, and next steps 

- Follow up when responses, reports, assessments, or decisions are overdue 

- Monitor insurer commitments and follow up agreed actions within the required timeframes 

- Escalate delays, issues, or concerns promptly to the Claims Consultant 



Documentation and Information Requests 

- Request required claim documentation, including causation reports, damage photos, dates of loss or event, quotes, scopes of work, invoices, receipts, proof of ownership, repair or replacement information, and any other documentation required by the insurer 

- Send follow-up correspondence to clients or relevant parties only as instructed by the Claims Consultant, and report progress on outstanding documentation 

- File and record all information received accurately in the appropriate claim file and system 



Claims Administration 

- Monitor open claims and maintain accurate, current claim records 

- Diary and action follow-ups to keep claims progressing 

- Review insurer correspondence, identify outstanding actions, and prepare relevant information for the Claims Consultant 

- Maintain organised claim files and save all correspondence and supporting documentation correctly 

- Complete general claims administration and other tasks as directed by the Claims Consultant 





** Policy Servicing and Administrative Support **

 

- Manage and service an existing portfolio of clients across Builders Warranty and Construction policies, including changes, amendments, cancellations, and occupancy permit submissions 

- Prepare quotes, policy documentation, renewals, endorsements, amendments, and cancellations 

- Assist brokers with assessing client needs and sourcing, negotiating, and placing suitable insurance policies with insurers 

- Maintain and update client databases, policy records, and CRM documentation accurately and promptly 

- Provide day-to-day administrative support to the broking team, including data entry, filing, and document management 

- Handle and liaise with insurers on behalf of clients on policy and servicing matters 

- Manage client enquiries professionally and efficiently through the firm’s approved communication channels 

- Build and maintain professional working relationships with clients and insurers, within the role’s defined authority 

- Identify and refer appropriate upsell or cross-sell opportunities to the broking team 

- Follow industry regulations, internal procedures, and documentation standards 

- Support the team with ad-hoc administrative tasks and projects as required 





SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 



You Must Have 

- 3 - 4 years of administrative or office support experience in general insurance, working for an Australian-based insurance broker 

- Hands-on experience in general insurance claims lodgement and claims management (not life, health, or superannuation) 

- Familiarity with general insurance terminology and insurer portals. 

- Well organised and highly motivated, with strong time-management skills and the ability to prioritise tasks, manage multiple clients, and meet deadlines 

- Ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment 

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer-focused approach 

- Confident negotiation and problem-solving abilities 

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy 

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint 

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team 



Nice to have

- Experience using Insight or Office Tech broking systems 

- Experience managing or servicing Builders Warranty and Construction policy portfolios, including changes, amendments, cancellations, and occupancy permit submissions 

- Understanding of insurance products, policy wordings, and risk assessment 

- Proficiency with insurance broking systems 

- Tier 1 RG146 qualification 





**To Apply**

title: Expert Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Sourcer — Full-Time, Premium Pay
description:
Company: AckeeArkadia



Compensation: $10–$12 USD/hour, based on demonstrated experience



Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week, Flexible schedule



Location: Remote



Payment Method: PayPal ONLY

About the Opportunity



AckeeArkadia is seeking an exceptional, experienced Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage (OA) sourcing specialist for a U.S.-based e-commerce operation.



This is NOT an entry-level position.



We are looking for a proven sourcer who consistently discovers profitable, purchase-ready inventory opportunities with minimal supervision.



We offer premium compensation for premium talent and are interested in establishing a long-term working relationship with a professional who delivers measurable results.



Our sourcing philosophy prioritizes low-risk, high-confidence opportunities that generate sustainable profits without exposing our Amazon seller account to unnecessary risks.

Primary Responsibilities



    Consistently deliver a minimum target of 3 fully actionable, purchase-ready product leads per working day.



    Independently source profitable inventory from legitimate U.S. retailers and trustworthy suppliers.



    Use ArbiSource, Keepa, SellerAmp SAS, and advanced manual sourcing techniques to discover and validate opportunities.



    Verify product identity, sales demand, profit margins, competition, pricing stability, supplier legitimacy, and selling eligibility.



    Proactively identify retail arbitrage (RA) BOLO opportunities, clearance events, major discounts, and profitable bulk-purchasing opportunities.



    Monitor multiple product categories, including toys, collectibles, household products, accessories, and other profitable categories.



    Document sourcing results with accurate calculations and verifiable supporting evidence.



    Exercise independent judgment and reject products that present unacceptable business, authenticity, compliance, or account-health risks.



Minimum Product Requirements



All actionable leads must meet the following standards:



    ROI: Minimum 30%.



    Net Profit: Minimum $3 per unit after applicable expenses and Amazon fees.



    Sales Demand: At least 30 estimated monthly sales, supported by reliable product-specific evidence.



    Competition: Generally no more than 15–20 competing FBA sellers.



    Product Identity: Exact ASIN, UPC, model, size, color, variation, and pack-configuration match.



    Pricing: Stable selling prices supported by historical Keepa data.



    Inventory: Confirmed availability from a trustworthy supplier.



    Eligibility: Verified Amazon selling approval without unresolved restrictions.



    Account Safety: No unacceptable authenticity, intellectual-property, compliance, or account-health concerns.



Variation-specific demand verification is essential. Parent-level product sales estimates alone are not sufficient.



Incomplete, speculative, or inadequately researched products do not count toward the daily lead target.



Promising BOLO and speculative opportunities should be reported separately and are encouraged, but do not replace purchase-ready leads.

Required Experience and Skills



Advanced, hands-on experience with all three sourcing tools is mandatory.



ArbiSource



    Advanced sourcing, filtering, and opportunity identification.



    Independent verification of automated sourcing results.



    Identifying profitable opportunities beyond basic ROI calculations.



Keepa



    Advanced interpretation of pricing, sales rank, Buy Box, and competition history.



    Evaluating sales velocity and price sustainability.



    Understanding variation-specific sales performance.



    Recognizing misleading demand and temporary profitability.



SellerAmp SAS



    Accurate profitability and Amazon fee calculations.



    Product identification and competition analysis.



    Evaluating restrictions and relevant product risk indicators.



Additional Requirements



    Proven professional Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage sourcing experience.



    Strong understanding of Amazon selling restrictions and compliance.



    Extensive experience sourcing from U.S. retailers.



    Proven ability to independently identify profitable products.



    Strong documentation and research skills.



    Excellent communication and professional reliability.



    Ability to work independently with minimal instruction.



Onboarding and Performance Expectations



The selected candidate will receive one paid working day to familiarize themselves with our account, purchasing requirements, sourcing processes, and expectations.



Applicants must already possess the necessary sourcing expertise. Beginner sourcing training will not be provided.



After orientation, the normal performance expectation is a minimum of three fully actionable product leads per working day.



We recognize that legitimate sourcing opportunities can fluctuate. An occasional day without qualifying leads is understandable when accompanied by clear documentation of sourcing activity, opportunities examined, and reasons for rejection.



However, repeated zero-lead days, particularly multiple occurrences within the same working week, are unacceptable.



Performance is evaluated on the accuracy, quality, consistency, and actual purchase viability of submitted opportunities.



This is a performance-driven engagement. Continued work is contingent on meeting our standards, and significant or repeated performance deficiencies may result in termination of the engagement within the same week, consistent with applicable agreement terms.

Compensation and Payment Requirements



    Hourly Pay: $10–$12 USD, based on experience.



    Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week.



    Payment Method: PayPal ONLY.



    Potential performance-based incentives.



    Opportunity for an ongoing professional relationship with a growing U.S. e-commerce business.



IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



All compensation is paid exclusively through PayPal.



We currently do not have access to alternative payment platforms and cannot accommodate payments through Wise, Payoneer, direct bank transfers, or other services.



The advertised hourly rate represents gross compensation before any applicable PayPal transaction, receiving, or currency-conversion fees.



The contractor is responsible for any PayPal fees deducted from their payments, subject to applicable law. These fees will not be reimbursed by the company.



Applicants must have an active PayPal account capable of receiving payments and must be comfortable with these payment arrangements.



If you cannot accept payment through PayPal under these conditions, please do not apply. This requirement is non-negotiable.

How to Apply



Please provide the following information:



1. Professional Experience



How many years have you worked as an Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage sourcer? Briefly describe your prior sourcing responsibilities.



2. Software Expertise



Describe your experience using ArbiSource, Keepa, and SellerAmp SAS. How do you typically incorporate all three tools into your sourcing process?



3. Proven Performance



How many genuinely purchase-ready leads did you consistently deliver per day in your most recent sourcing position?



4. Sourcing Examples



Provide two anonymized examples of profitable products you personally sourced, including purchase price, ROI, net profit, estimated monthly sales, and your verification process.



Do not disclose confidential employer information.



5. Risk Assessment



Describe an apparently profitable product you rejected and explain the specific warning signs that influenced your decision.



Important: Applications that fail to demonstrate substantial hands-on sourcing experience or omit the requested information may be disqualified.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to a brief interview. No sourcing assessment or access to our business accounts is required during recruitment.

Final Note



We are seeking an exceptional, independent sourcing professional who is ready to deliver results from the beginning.



We are not looking for someone who merely generates long lists of potentially profitable products. We are looking for a specialist who consistently identifies genuine purchasing opportunities supported by thorough research.



We value expertise, independent thinking, reliability, and measurable results.



If you have the experience, discipline, and proven track record to consistently discover profitable Amazon FBA opportunities, we encourage you to apply.

title: SENIOR RECRUITER – TALENT ACQUISITION STRATEGY & ANALYTICS
description:
SENIOR RECRUITER – TALENT ACQUISITION STRATEGY & ANALYTICS

Schedule: Full night shift aligned with U.S. Pacific Time business hours



ABOUT THE ROLE



Starbond is looking for an experienced Senior Recruiter to lead end-to-end recruitment and develop effective hiring strategies to support our growth.



We need someone who combines strong recruiting skills with strategic thinking, data analysis, and sound judgment. Beyond sourcing and interviewing, you will assess hiring challenges, analyze recruitment performance, identify bottlenecks, and recommend practical improvements.



You must have at least 10 years of total recruitment experience, including at least 4 years recruiting for U.S.-based roles, with demonstrated experience filling on-site positions.



HOW TO APPLY



Applications will be reviewed through
 only. We will not screen applications or resumes submitted through OnlineJobs.ph.



Please
 
 with the subject line: Senior Recruiter Application – [Your Name]



Include your updated resume and a link to a 3–5 minute Loom video introduction.



In your video, discuss the U.S.-based roles you have recruited for, particularly on-site positions, including industries and seniority levels. Explain your direct responsibilities throughout the recruitment process.



Share one challenging U.S. hiring search, the strategy you used, and the outcome. Also provide an example of how you used recruitment data to identify a problem or improve hiring results.



Ensure your Loom video link is accessible without requesting permission. Both your resume and Loom video are required for your application to be considered.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Recruitment Strategy and Hiring Partnership



Partner with hiring managers to clarify business needs, role requirements, priorities, and hiring timelines. Create clear job descriptions, candidate profiles, screening criteria, and interview plans.



Develop sourcing strategies based on each role’s complexity, location, compensation, and available talent pool. Identify hiring challenges early, including compensation gaps, limited candidate availability, and restrictive requirements.



Recommend changes to sourcing channels, candidate profiles, job positioning, or selection processes based on results and market feedback. Help hiring managers distinguish essential qualifications from skills that can be developed after hiring.



End-to-End Recruitment



Manage sourcing, screening, interviewing, candidate evaluation, reference checks, offer coordination, and onboarding handoff. Recruit for U.S.-based, on-site roles and other positions across the organization.



Source through job boards, LinkedIn, Boolean search, referrals, direct outreach, and talent networks. Build candidate pipelines for current and anticipated hiring needs.



Conduct structured interviews and submit clear candidate assessments supported by specific examples. Maintain timely candidate communication and proactively follow up on feedback and hiring decisions.



Recruitment Analytics and Reporting



Maintain accurate recruitment records and dashboards. Analyze the recruitment funnel, from applications reviewed and candidates contacted through interviews, qualified endorsements, offers, and hires.



Track time to first qualified endorsement, stage conversion rates, time to fill, sourcing effectiveness, offer acceptance, and candidate withdrawals. Investigate where candidates drop out or fail to progress.



Identify whether hiring challenges stem from sourcing, candidate qualifications, role attractiveness, or internal decision-making. Present reports explaining what the data shows, possible causes, and recommended actions.



Measure whether strategy changes improve candidate quality, conversion rates, or hiring speed.



Process Improvement and Candidate Experience



Improve recruitment workflows for efficiency, consistency, and candidate experience. Develop screening tools, interview guides, evaluation scorecards, communication templates, and recruitment SOPs.



Use candidate and hiring manager feedback to improve the hiring process. Apply recruiting tools, automation, and AI while maintaining accuracy and sound judgment.



Support structured onboarding and a smooth transition from candidate to new hire.



Additional HR Support



Assist with offer letters, contracts, onboarding documents, and other HR records. Maintain accurate and confidential candidate and employee information.



Support employee engagement, performance review coordination, training activities, and other HR initiatives as needed. Maintain recruitment as your primary focus while balancing assigned HR support responsibilities.

title: Staff Accountant
description:
Staff Accountant 

Full-Time | Remote / Offshore 



Position Summary 

We are seeking a Staff Accountant to support the accounting operations of a growing, multi-entity real estate organization. The position will work closely with finance leadership and support general ledger accounting, accounts payable, balance sheet reconciliations, expense management, and monthly and annual close activities. 



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

General Ledger & Balance Sheet Accounting 

Maintain general ledger records and prepare recurring and adjusting journal entries across multiple legal entities. 

Prepare and reconcile bank, credit card, asset, liability, intercompany, and other balance sheet accounts, including supporting schedules for fixed assets, depreciation, prepaids, accruals, and debt. 

Research reconciliation differences, unusual balances, and account activity and communicate findings to finance leadership. 



Accounts Payable & Expense Management 

Manage day-to-day accounts payable, including invoice coding, approval routing, vendor records, payment preparation, and follow-up on outstanding items. 

Ensure expenses are recorded to the appropriate entity, account, property, department, and accounting period. 

Support implementation and ongoing administration of an expense management platform, including transaction review, receipts, coding, reimbursements, and issue resolution. 



Month-End & Year-End Close 

Complete assigned close procedures, including reconciliations, accruals, reclassifications, depreciation, amortization, and supporting schedules. 

Review account activity for missing transactions, classification issues, unusual balances, and significant fluctuations. 

Assist with financial statement preparation and provide supporting documentation for external tax, accounting, and other professional service providers. 



Multi-Entity & Accounting Operations 

Record and reconcile transactions across affiliated entities, including intercompany and due-to/due-from balances. 

Work with property-level accounting reports and supporting information from property management systems and third-party property managers. 

Maintain organized accounting records and assist with accounting procedures, controls, system improvements, and recurring close processes. 





Required Qualifications

3-5 years of professional accounting experience. 

Strong understanding of accrual accounting, journal entries, general ledger accounting, balance sheet reconciliations, accounts payable, and month-end close. 

Experience preparing account reconciliations and maintaining supporting schedules. 

Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills. 

Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. 

Strong written and spoken English communication skills and ability to manage multiple responsibilities in a remote environment.

Experience with multi-entity accounting and intercompany reconciliations.

Work Arrangement 

Full-time remote / offshore position with regular working-hour overlap with the U.S. Mountain Time Zone.

title: Wordpress Developer
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based digital marketing agency looking for a full-time Web Developer to build, maintain, and optimize websites for our clients.



You will work across a live portfolio of 30+ client sites in home services, healthcare, med spas, hospitality, professional services, and e-commerce catalogs ranging from a handful of products to several thousand SKUs. On any given week you might be building a new Elementor landing page for a PPC campaign, fixing a broken checkout on a WooCommerce store, migrating a site to a new host, or cutting a page's load time in half.



WORK SCHEDULE



- 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST (U.S. Eastern Time)

- 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippines Time

- 40 hours per week

- Monday to Friday



HOW WE WORK (PLEASE READ THIS PART)



Tasks come to you detailed and specified, not as one-line requests. A typical ticket includes the target URL, a reference design or comp, the exact copy, the assets, the acceptance criteria, and which staging or live environment to work in. We do this on purpose. You should not have to guess what "make the hero better" means. In exchange, we expect the work to come back matching the spec, tested on mobile and desktop, published to the correct environment, and reported back with a live link, not left sitting in an editor.



We are also an AI-assisted shop. Our team uses Claude (Anthropic's AI) daily as part of real production work: generating and reviewing code, scripting bulk content and product updates, driving WordPress and Shopify through their APIs, auditing pages, and automating the repetitive parts of site maintenance. You are not expected to arrive as an expert in this. You are expected to be genuinely interested in it and willing to learn, because it is how we move fast across this many client sites. If you already use Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or similar tools in your development workflow, tell us how in your application.



To be clear on the other side of that: AI helps you write and check the work, it does not excuse it. You own what you publish. We would rather you slow down and verify on the live URL than ship something that "should" work.



TOOLS WE USE



- Microsoft Teams for daily communication and standups

- ClickUp / Trello / Asana for task and project management

- Google Drive for documentation, assets, and tracking

- WordPress / Elementor (heaviest) / Divi / Gutenberg

- Shopify (themes, Liquid, admin, apps)

- WooCommerce

- Claude and AI tooling for development and automation

- Google Search Console and Google Analytics (GA4)

- Ahrefs / SEMrush / Screaming Frog

- PageSpeed Insights / GTmetrix

- cPanel, SiteGround, Hostinger, Cloudflare, and similar hosting stacks

- Canva or similar for light graphics



RESPONSIBILITIES



Build and maintain



- Build, edit, and maintain WordPress websites across multiple client accounts at the same time

- Build pages in Elementor to match a provided design comp or reference site, accurately, including spacing, typography, color tokens, and mobile breakpoints

- Build and maintain Shopify stores: product pages, collections, theme sections, navigation, and front-end adjustments in HTML, CSS, and Liquid

- Create and update landing pages, service pages, location pages, blog pages, and site sections from written specs

- Customize WordPress themes, child themes, and page builder templates, including light PHP work where needed

- Manage WooCommerce catalogs: products, variations, categories, pricing, and bulk imports and updates

- Handle site migrations, staging-to-live pushes, DNS changes, and hosting moves



Fix and optimize



- Troubleshoot plugin conflicts, broken layouts, mobile responsiveness issues, form failures, SMTP and
 delivery problems, and general site errors independently, and document what you found

- Improve site speed and Core Web Vitals: caching, image optimization and WebP conversion, script and CSS cleanup, render-blocking fixes

- Keep sites secure and current with backups, plugin and theme updates, cleanup of abandoned plugins, and basic hardening



SEO and tracking



- Execute on-page and basic technical SEO: title tags, meta descriptions, heading structure, image alt text, internal linking, redirects, schema where specified, sitemap and indexing checks

- Publish and format blog posts with correct headings, images, links, and SEO fields

- Implement on-page updates handed down from our SEO team's strategy

- Set up and verify Google Search Console, GA4, conversion tracking, and pixels when needed



Work with the team



- Collaborate with our SEO, PPC, social, and design staff to support live campaigns, often on a deadline tied to an ad launch

- Provide clear daily written updates: what you completed, what is blocked, and the live links to verify

- Flag problems early. A task that turns out to be twice the size it looked is fine. Finding that out on the due date is not.



REQUIREMENTS



- 2 to 3+ years hands-on, professional experience building and managing WordPress sites

- Strong Elementor skills specifically. You can rebuild a design comp in Elementor without it falling apart on mobile

- Experience with Shopify: themes, product pages, collections, and store updates

- Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals. Basic PHP is a strong plus

- Basic Shopify Liquid knowledge preferred

- Working knowledge of WooCommerce

- Strong grasp of on-page and basic technical SEO

- Proven experience improving page speed, mobile responsiveness, and user experience

- Comfortable in Search Console, GA4, PageSpeed Insights, and standard SEO tools

- Able to troubleshoot independently. You research, test, and solve before escalating

- Genuine attention to detail on layouts, links, images, and SEO fields. You check your own work on the live URL before calling it done

- Able to juggle multiple client sites and deadlines without dropping tasks

- Strong written English, since most of our communication is written

- Self-motivated and reliable on the U.S. night shift

- Reliable internet connection and your own computer or laptop

- Interest in AI-assisted development (Claude or similar). Prior experience is a bonus, not a requirement



NICE TO HAVE



- Agency experience

- Site migrations, DNS, cPanel, Cloudflare, and hosting administration

- Git and version control

- Working with REST APIs (WordPress REST API, Shopify Admin API)

- Experience with large product catalogs or bulk data imports

- Custom plugin or theme development



TO APPLY



- Write the word "Web" at the top of your application

- Include links to websites you have built, managed, or optimized: WordPress sites, Shopify stores, and landing pages

- For each link, write a short description of your specific role: design, development, maintenance, speed optimization, SEO, or troubleshooting. Tell us what you actually did, not what the agency did

- Describe one website problem you diagnosed and fixed yourself, and how you found it

- If you use AI tools in your development work, tell us which ones and what you use them for



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

title: B2B SaaS Account Executive – Full Sales Cycle (US Market)
description:
B2B SaaS Account Executive – Full Sales Cycle (US Market)



Remote – Philippines | Full-Time | Base Salary + Uncapped Commissions





ABOUT REPUTATIONSTACKER



ReputationStacker is an established US-based SaaS company helping businesses generate more customer reviews, manage their online reputation, and turn customer feedback into actionable business insights.



Our platform includes automated review requests, review monitoring, sentiment analysis, AI-powered review replies, and multi-location reporting.



We're hiring an experienced B2B salesperson to independently build a pipeline of US business prospects and convert them into paying customers.



IMPORTANT: This is a full-cycle sales position with a strong emphasis on outbound prospecting. We do not provide warm leads or prequalified appointments.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



You'll own the entire sales process, from identifying prospects to closing deals.



• Develop your prospecting strategy: Identify promising customer segments, research target businesses, find decision-makers, and continually refine your outreach approach.



• Generate your own pipeline: Proactively engage US businesses through outbound calls, personalized
s, LinkedIn, and other effective channels.



• Build relationships and create demand: Understand prospects' challenges, establish credibility, and demonstrate how ReputationStacker can benefit their businesses.



• Conduct demos and close sales: Qualify prospects, present the software, handle objections, negotiate, and convert opportunities into paying customers.



• Manage and optimize your pipeline: Track activity and opportunities in our CRM, follow up consistently, and improve conversion rates.



• Collaborate on larger deals: Work with company leadership when additional support would help close substantial or complex opportunities.



Our primary targets include small and midsize businesses, multi-location operators, franchise groups, and regional chains.



Leadership can assist with larger deals, but you'll be responsible for developing opportunities to the point where prospects understand the product, its value to their business, and approximate pricing before any handoff.



Success is measured by paying customers and revenue generated—not appointments booked.





COMPENSATION & EARNING POTENTIAL



Base salary: $1,200–$1,800 USD/month, depending on experience, plus uncapped commissions.



• 15% of first-year collected subscription revenue for deals you independently close.



• 7.5% of first-year collected subscription revenue for opportunities you originate and substantially develop that company leadership closes.



• Commissions include additional locations activated by your customers during their original 12-month commission period.



Our average subscription revenue is approximately $100 per business location per month.



Examples of first-year commissions for a single independently closed customer:



• 1 location = $180 commission

• 10 locations = $1,800 commission

• 25 locations = $4,500 commission

• 50 locations = $9,000 commission



Commissions are in addition to your base salary and paid as customer revenue is collected. Examples assume 12 months of payments, with no cancellations or discounts. Actual earnings depend on sales results and customer retention.





WHAT WE OFFER



• An established SaaS product with an existing customer base.

• Product training, demo access, sales materials, and CRM/outreach tools.

• Freedom to develop and refine your own prospecting strategy.

• Direct collaboration with experienced US-based company leadership.

• Customer onboarding and ongoing support handled by our team.

• Long-term growth potential, including increased responsibilities and compensation based on performance.





REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• 3+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably selling SaaS, software, digital marketing, or recurring business services to US customers.



• Proven success independently generating prospects and personally closing deals you originated. Appointment-setting experience or closing company-provided leads alone does not qualify.



• Strong outbound prospecting, relationship-building, discovery, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.



• Excellent spoken and written English, with confidence communicating directly with US business owners and executives.



• Experience conducting live software demos and using CRM and sales outreach tools.



• Self-directed, resourceful, organized, and accountable for results.



• Full-time availability with substantial overlap during US Pacific business hours.



• Reliable internet and a professional environment for customer calls.



Experience selling to franchises or multi-location businesses is a significant advantage.





HOW TO APPLY



Please submit the following:



1. Your resume/CV and LinkedIn profile (if available).



2. Your sales background: What products or services have you personally sold to US businesses?



3. Two specific B2B deals you've personally originated AND closed. For each, describe:



   • What you sold and the approximate deal value.

   • Who the buyer was.

   • How you identified and initially contacted the prospect.

   • How you developed the opportunity and closed the sale.

   • The approximate length of the sales cycle.



4. Your prospecting approach: How would you independently identify and approach potential US customers for a review-management SaaS platform, especially businesses with multiple locations?



5. A 1–2 minute video introduction describing your relevant experience and why you'd be successful in this role.



Finalists should be prepared to provide professional references or other reasonable verification of prior sales results.



Include "Full-Cycle Sales" in the subject line or first line of your application.



Applications without evidence of personally originating and closing B2B sales, or without a video introduction, will not be considered.



We're looking for an accomplished salesperson who enjoys creating opportunities from scratch, developing business relationships, and closing deals—and wants to be rewarded for the revenue they generate.
